Our road system is one of our empire's most valuable assets. To further benefit our military and administration, we will erect tambo way stations along all the main roads. These stations will be built within a day's march of each other, and will provide shelter and carry supplies for travelers.

The mit'a is a mandatory public service system fundamental to Incan society, and forms the backbone of the military service. Every ayllu must contribute capable men, adapted to combat in the highlands, to provide labor for state projects and military service.

In order to undertake great building projects in the past, our rulers had to fulfill ancient traditions by inviting every single petty chief in our empire to the capital, showering them with gifts, and holding lavish feasts. As our state grows, however, this is far from an ideal way to undertake these projects. Supplying labor and materials for construction should be the duty of each and every chief in our lands.

The Tambo is a supply depot of the Incas. The purpose of the Tambo varies significantly depending on the size of the structure. Smaller tambos serve as road stops for passing travelers while larger ones can even serve as an office for the province's administration.

No other empire is as well adapted to the heights of the Andes as we are. By maintaining settlements and storehouses at every altitude, from the lowest valleys to the highest plateaus, we have mastered the method of moving men and goods across the most difficult terrain, where other states would falter. Our llama caravans, our roads carved into sheer cliffsides, and our highland communities turn the Andes from a barrier into our own highway.

The warachikuy is a holy ceremony where young men are tested in their skills, valor, and wits, as well as their physical abilities like racing, marksmanship, combat, and durability for extended lengths of sleep deprivation. Those who pass these tests with excellence are promoted to the rank of officers for our ever-growing army.

Llamas have many functions in our society. They act as beasts of burden, as sacrifices, provide meat and wool, and even give us fertilizer for our crops with their dung. Controlling the breeding and use of llamas through government michis, or herders, we ensure that the llama population is strictly monitored. This will provide an opportunity for the llama population to increase

A system which uses knots on a string to store information, do accounting, and perform other informational tasks. Each knot represents a number from zero to nine. The knots can also be used to refer to logograms on the same string. The knots show which syllable in the logogram to use, and by combining more strings, sentences can be formed.

The Hatun Runas are the peasant class of our empire. One in fifty men are chosen for military service on their twenty-fifth birthdays, and conscripted for the next seven years. This conscription system helps us maintain a substantial professional army with superior discipline than the troops of our adversaries.

Invaders from strange lands have set foot in our territory, and threaten our very existence. But our armies are adaptive; they adjust to new enemy tactics, learn to wield their very own weapons against them, and fight with an unbreakable resolve inspired by their foes.

items.name: The Timurids
items.desc: The many battles fought by our ancestors may have soaked the earth in blood, but that bloodshed in turn fed the soil, and from this adversity was born a race of warriors, architects, artists, and scientists. The time has come to share our many gifts with the world by stepping forward as a great nation. We will follow chg timur lame borjigin's legacy, and lead our people to greatness!

adv.d: As the great Genghis Khān dominated the steppes with the power of his cavalry, so will we triumph through our incomparable horses. Bred for the most rigorous combat, and mounted by the best-trained soldiers in the world, our cavalry will instill fear in the hearts of our enemies.
This new variety of chess, invented by our great eponymous founder, improves upon previous versions. Using it will help our generals to improve their strategic and tactical skills.

adv.n: The Mantle of the Great Khān
adv.d: The death of Genghis Khān created a power vacuum that led to people who should have known better vying to replace him. However, through strategic marriages, we have consolidated our claim to descent from the Great Khān himself, and the warriors of the steppes will declare their loyalty to us accordingly.

The architecture of Persia has been the envy of the known world for centuries. We must promote a new form of architecture, one that surpasses anything seen before, so that we may claim our birthright as the master of this art.

Persia has always been the undeniable center of culture and language in the region, influencing the different Turkic peoples that have been around for centuries. We will embrace this blend of cultures to create our own unique tradition.

The Karluk language of the eastern steppes is far more worthy to carry the thoughts and ideas of our great lineage than Persian or Arabic ever could be. We must promote the use of our ancestral language, and create a new literary tradition.

The Nambardar Levy, or čerig-i nambardar, refers to our troops that do not come from Mongolian or Turkic origins, but instead come from the native Iranian population. Thanks to them, we can build larger armies than would have been possible before.
As long as our merchants control the trade through the lands of Transoxiana and Samarkand, the trade of the Silk Road shall flow unhindered and the wealth of our dynasty will continue to grow.

Ever since the initial Timurid expansion, our realm has attracted the greatest artisans and wise men of the age. Through our continued patronage of art, science, and literature, we have made the cities of Herāt and Samarkand the brightest jewels in the world.

We are fortunate to be served by loyal and well-educated Farsi administrators, who have perfected the art of governance for generations. Sadly, however, a hereditary office is one that over time might stagnate and lack innovation. By reducing the number of inherited offices with each generation, we can make sure that we reward not only loyalty, but also ability. Able administrators must rise to high positions regardless of which family they come from.

Our glorious empire emerged from the legacy of great conquerors. It was the ferocity of Genghis Khān's troops that allowed him to conquer from Europe to China. As his successors, our troops will be as fearsome as the ones in his army.

items.name: The Two Sicilies
items.desc: The Two Sicilies...not a country, but a dream. A dream to unify the lands kissed by the waters of the Straits of Messina — the Sicilies that stand on both sides of the 'Punta del Faro.' It is our duty to make that dream come true.

adv.d: The territories which constitute our land have suffered revolts due to unjust applications of laws. In order to prevent these occurrences in the future, we should standardize our legal code and ensure our laws are applied fairly. This will surely prevent any uprising from spiraling into chaos.

The Noble Families of both Sicilies exert much power in our stead. By granting them prestigious yet meaningless roles at court, we will ensure their loyalty and guarantee stable rule over our countryside.

Previous rulers put too much focus on particular areas of our country. If we want to retain control of both Sicilies, we will have to invest equally and fairly in both parts. One step towards this goal is attracting people to settle in previously neglected areas.

Expanding our territories within Italy is a difficult task, navigating a treacherous web of alliances and risking the anger of the Pope himself. Therefore, we should look overseas, where potential riches await us in the lands of northern Africa and Greece.

A particular struggle of our unified country is governing both sides of the Strait of Messina. Since our ruler can only be present on one side at a time, the other will have to be given to a vicar, ruling in our name. We must be sure to appoint only the most capable and trustworthy people to this vital role to prevent corruption.
Our coastline is vast, and vulnerable to raids by pirates hunting for slaves. We need to establish a navy to patrol, protect, and eventually defeat this vile threat to our people.

items.name: Yamato
items.desc: The Yamato is ancient, and claims descent from the gods themselves. Their very existence grants them a claim to the divine leadership of all Japan. And who would be so arrogant as to stand against the seed of the gods and their rightful rule?

items.name: Yuán
items.desc: Yuán

items.name: Albania
items.desc: Traditionally a land of diverse beliefs and disparate clans, we have finally united the Albanian people under a single banner and purpose. Now that we have expelled unwelcome outsiders and created a nascent state, Albania shall emerge as the heroic home nation of all Albanian people.

cond.t: Only if you started as Albania (ALB)

adv.d: Our latest crowned heads can be traced directly to the lineage of the Capetian House of Anjou, specifically established by Charles I of Naples to serve as his gateway into the Byzantine heartlands. This connection grants us a unique Western prestige among the fragmented Balkan lords, allowing us to claim a seat at the table of the great Catholic monarchs of Europe. By upholding the honors and heraldry of the Lily, we distinguish our sovereignty from that of mere tribal chieftains.

As the power of our foes wanes, our great houses have united to ensure the survival of our nation. By leveraging our position between the Catholic West and the Orthodox East, we have become masters of maritime diplomacy and coastal trade. This strategic autonomy allows us to navigate the rivalries of neighbors to our own benefit.

Our urban centers continue to operate under both the sophisticated principles of Byzantine Law and the modern bureaucracies of the West. This legal continuity provides a stable framework for contracts, property rights, and inheritance that attracts foreign merchants and scholars to our courts. A predictable legal system is the foundation of our growing administrative strength.

cond.t: Only if you started as Albania (ALB)

adv.d: As the primary port for Western intervention, we have modernized the shipyards of Durrës to maintain a permanent fleet of galleys. This infrastructure allows us to project power across the Adriatic, ensuring that the sea lanes between Naples and Albania remain open for reinforcements and trade. Our control of the harbor makes us the undisputed masters of the western Balkan coastline.

cond.t: Only if you started as Albania (ALB)

adv.d: Positioned as the easternmost outpost of the Roman Church, we have become the primary shield against both Orthodox schismatics and Turkish heathens. This sacred duty gives us an inner peace that infuses the entire realm, transforming our struggle into a crusade for our soul.

b: Damage Done versus Heathens in Battle: +10%
adv.d: Despite our communities being divided by faith, our nation is devoted to Christ, earning us the title of Athleta Christi. Our relentless faith has drawn the eyes of the Papacy and the Patriarchs, securing us financial subsidies and military volunteers. We fight not just for our land, but for the very survival of the 'Word of Christ'.

cond.t: Only if you started as Albania (ALB)

adv.d: Our position allows us to act as the essential bridge between the Italian city-states and the rugged Balkan interior. Our diplomats are trained to navigate both the Venetian Senate and tribal councils, making our mediation indispensable for trade and war.

Over time, a good number of our people have emigrated abroad and formed Arbëreshë communities. These 'Albanians across the sea' maintain our language and traditions while gaining influence in their new homes. They serve as permanent diplomatic envoys there, constantly lobbying for support for the homeland.

The merchants of our coast have become the primary carriers of trade between the Balkans and the West. By utilizing the Greek language for commerce and Albanian for loyalty, they dominate the markets from Venice to Constantinople. These merchant marines are the lifeblood of our modernizing economy.

cond.t: Only if you started as Albania (ALB)

adv.d: We will not rest until the borders of the ancient Kingdom are restored to their greatest extent and beyond, reclaiming our place as masters of the Balkans. This centralizing mission allows us to integrate newly conquered territories with minimal friction as we restore 'rightful' rule.

cond.t: Only if you started as Albania (ALB)

adv.d: Following the European trend, our monarchs have centralized power, stripping the old clans of their feudal privileges in favor of a modern state. This move has allowed us to implement universal taxation and a national judicial system, turning the kingdom into a streamlined machine of war.

Our 'National Rebirth' or Rilindja has ignited a fire in the hearts of Albanians everywhere, from the mountains of the north to the diaspora in Italy and Egypt. This cultural and political movement has unified all Albanians under the common banner of 'Albanianism'. We are a nation reborn, ready to take our place among the sovereign states of Europe.

items.name: Algiers
items.desc: The central Maghreb has scattered its strength among corsair ports, mountain confederations, and desert sultanates, each proud and each alone. We shall gather the Tell, the Kabyle highlands, and the gateways of the Sahara beneath a single throne, turning fractious coasts and restless tribes into one sovereign power. Let Algiers stand as the beating heart of a realm that answers to no master but itself.

adv.d: Our fortress-quarter, the qasba of Algiers perched on the hillside above the harbor with its honeycomb of narrow alleys and tightly-built houses, provides the defensive seat from which every Algerian regime governs. Our resident garrisons hold the citadel against any landward or seaward attack, our cisterns store enough water and grain for an extended siege, and our gatekeepers control access to the upper city even when the lower harbor is held by an enemy. This kasbah citadel gives our polity a fortified administrative core that the more open Maghrebi coastal cities cannot match for defensive resilience.

cond.t: Only if you started as Algiers (ALG)

adv.d: Our dynasty, the Banū Tha'ālibī, traced through Sīdī 'Abd ar-Raḥmān ath-Tha'ālibī and his ancestors back to Idrīs II of Morocco and the Prophet's grandson Ḥasan, establishes a sharīfī lineage in the central Maghreb that no Berber dynasty can match for prophetic-genealogical authority. Our court genealogists certify the descent at each accession, our recital of the lineage at every bay'a ceremony binds the religious caste to the ruling family, and our nobles-and-ulema consensus around the sharifian claim survives every internal succession-dispute. This sharifian-descent claim gives the original Algiers line a sacral legitimacy that no successor adopting the Algerian state-form can replicate from genealogical fact.

Algiers emerges as the central coastal emporium of the central Maghreb. Merchants of Pisa, Genoa, Aragon, and Provence maintain resident factors in our harbor, our customs revenue from Christian trade rivals the income of the inland tribute, and our shipwrights at the harbor-front yards build both the coastal traders and the early war-galleys that our captains crew. Our merchant-guilds intermediate the wool, wax, leather, coral, and slaves that flow between the Tell hinterland and the Mediterranean markets, and our consul-treaty regime grants formal residence and judicial protection to the visiting foreign factors. This commercial emergence gives Algiers a port-revenue and sailor-pool foundation that the later corsair-era state-form is built upon.

cond.t: Only if you started as Algiers (ALG)

adv.d: The Tha'alibid emirate ruling Algiers, proclaimed under the religious-political authority of the Banū Tha'ālibī family and exercising state powers across the central-Maghrebi coast from Cherchell to Dellys, maintains a continuous diplomatic-and-commercial relations regime with the Aragonese, Genoese, and Hafsid neighbors that the later regency inherits in form if not in dynastic continuity. Our court chancellery exchanges sealed letters with the Christian powers under formal capitulations, our ports admit foreign factors under negotiated residence-rights, and our coinage bears the sharifian titulature that distinguishes our emirate from the Zayyanid Tlemcen and Hafsid Tunis polities. This pre-regency emirate gives the original Algiers line a state-form patrimony that no successor regime restores in equivalent dynastic terms.

The Algiers Ojaq Janissaries are the musketeer ojaq of the Algerian Regency, an Ottoman-trained Janissary garrison founded after the Barbarossa brothers took Algiers and steadily reinforced with Anatolian recruits. They hold the Kasbah and the coastal forts and elect their own Aga, who shares power with the Dey.

The corsair tradition takes root in Algiers. Captains from across the Mediterranean settle in our harbor under state charter, our shipwrights specialize in the fast galley-and-galiot classes that the open-water raiding war demands, and our captains' guild formalizes the prize-distribution rules that turn private raiding into a state-organized industry. Our renegade Christian, Greek, and Italian captains serve alongside native rais; our markets re-export the captured cargoes and ransomed captives; and our crown takes its share of every successful prize. This corsair emergence gives Algiers a maritime war-economy that the more agriculturally-anchored Maghrebi rivals cannot replicate from their own captain-traditions.

cond.t: Only if you started as Algiers (ALG)

adv.d: Our emirate resists the multiple foreign pressures bearing down on Algiers in the late-medieval period: Spanish coastal raids and Cardinal Cisneros's expeditions, foreign corsair-captains looking for a base under any pretext of religious solidarity, and the periodic Hafsid-Zayyanid neighbors seeking to incorporate us into their tributary networks. We retain seasoned mercenary and corsair companies whose upkeep our treasury has learned to bear, we press the siege against every foreign strongpoint planted on our coast — the Spanish-held Peñón foremost among them — and our diplomats negotiate the temporary truces that preserve our autonomous polity through each successive wave of foreign pressure. This martial tradition gives the original Algiers line an expeditionary-military patrimony that the later regency, paradoxically, would inherit and turn against the same powers.

The corsair-state economy reaches its mature form. Our crown licenses every prize-taking captain, our treasury draws a fixed share of every successful raid, and our shipyards turn out the standard galley, galiot, and xebec classes that our captains lease from the state on prize-share terms. Our recruiting agents draw foreign captains and crews to our harbor with state-funded advances on the next prize-cycle, our naval-administration office tracks the war-statuses of every Mediterranean power to direct the raiding effort, and our central treasury depends on the prize-revenue cycle as much as on the customs-and-tribute flows. This state-organized corsair economy gives our polity a war-revenue stream that the more conventional trading polities of the Mediterranean cannot match for institutional integration.

cond.t: Only if you started as Algiers (ALG)

adv.d: Our dynasty, restored to the throne after the foreign-officer interregnum and the upheavals that followed, reasserts the indigenous Algerian sovereignty that the original Tha'alibid line carried before its extinction. Our court re-establishes the diplomatic networks that the regency's chancellery had let lapse, our envoys re-engage the Mediterranean and trans-Saharan powers under the restored sharifian-legitimacy framework, and our scholar-historians produce the chronicles that justify the restoration in continuity-of-legitimacy terms. This restoration gives the original Algiers line a re-established diplomatic reach that purely-state-form successors could not muster in equivalent legitimacy terms.

The deylik settles into a stable political order: the dey rules from the Janina palace, the provincial beys remit tribute and troops, the Janissary corps stands as the army, and the corsair captains' guild keeps its voice in his election. After generations of coups and rotating officers, the treasury, the prize-licensing office, and the diplomatic apparatus at last run from a single Bardo-palace bureaucracy. This consolidated deylik gives our polity an administrative coherence the old rotating-officer governance could never sustain.

cond.t: Only if you started as Algiers (ALG)

adv.d: Our dynasty, elevated to sultanate status as the restored Algerian polity matures into a fully sovereign state, claims the same titulature and ceremonial protocol that the Hafsid and Marinid sovereigns wielded, distinguished from the Janissary-promoted deylik form by the unbroken dynastic-genealogical continuity that no rotating-officer regime can match. Our court at the Bardo-equivalent palace stages the formal accession ceremonies, our scholars compile the sultanate's claim-to-sovereignty in juridical commentaries, and our nobles' consensus binds the polity through dynastic-loyalty rather than corps-election. This Tha'alibid sultanate gives the original Algiers line a state-form fit for its sharifian legitimacy claim, where the dey-regency form rooted in Janissary promotion could not provide it.

Our consular-relations regime, with formal consulates from every major Mediterranean and Atlantic power resident in Algiers, periodic treaty renewals with each, and the customary gift-and-payment arrangements that accompany them, manages the polity's relations with rivals more powerful than any single defeat could humble. Our dey audiences the consular delegations on a fixed protocol, our chancellery files the running correspondence in multiple languages, and our customs office administrates the differential tariffs that each treaty-state's merchants enjoy. This formalized consular-and-treaty regime gives Algiers a diplomatic-administrative flexibility that the more isolated North African polities cannot match for managing the modern multi-power configuration.

cond.t: Only if you started as Algiers (ALG)

adv.d: Our reformist circles revive the Tha'alibid heritage as the ideological-cultural anchor of the modern Algerian polity, invoking the centuries before the Janissary interregnum when an indigenous sharifian dynasty governed central Algeria with continuous diplomatic-and-commercial engagement with the Mediterranean world. Our pamphleteers publish the Tha'alibid chronicles in modern Arabic editions, our schoolmasters teach the early-modern Algerian history alongside the Maghrebi-wide canonical narrative, and our scholar-circles around the Sīdī 'Abd ar-Raḥmān shrine in Algiers maintain the unbroken religious-cultural authority that no political extinction could fully erase. This Tha'alibid revival gives the original Algiers line a heritage-ideological patrimony that purely-state-form modernization movements elsewhere lack.

items.name: Aragon
items.desc: The Crown of Aragon was forged through the dynastic union of the highland kingdom and the maritime principalities of the Mediterranean coast, a partnership that has carried our banners from Zaragoza as far afield as Sicily and Naples. We must restore this royal patrimony and reclaim our rightful place among the great powers of Europe.

adv.d: Almogavars are a class of light infantry soldiers originating from the Crown of Aragon. These quick-moving warriors serve as frontier defenders and foot soldiers. In addition to their role in the Reconquista, they have also found employment as mercenaries in Italy, the Frankokratia, and the Levant.
Some of the fiercest and deadliest crossbowmen in the Western Mediterranean, the Catalan Crossbowmen compete against the Genoese Crossbowmen for supremacy in this field.
The Catalan Galley is a larger version of the ancient Greek galleys that once dominated the Mediterranean Sea.

cond.t: Only if you started as Aragon (ARA)

adv.d: The descent from the Pyrenean valleys onto the plain of the Ebro crowns generations of frontier war: Huesca falls in 1096, and Alfonso el Batallador storms Zaragoza in 1118 to make it the seat of the kingdom. Our light frontier foot soldiers, hardened in the long march south and skilled in the reduction of walled Moorish towns, turns each captured stronghold into a base for the next advance. This conquering tradition gives the inland kingdom a soldiery built for taking fortresses rather than for the sea.

Desperta Ferro! — Awake Iron! — is the war cry of the Almogavars, accompanied by the striking of lance shafts and darts against flint to draw sparks before the charge. The cry was heard at the conquest of Mallorca under James I in 1229, on the slopes of the Bosphorus under Roger de Flor's Catalan Company, and in every Aragonese campaign of the long Mediterranean century. This battlefield ritual binds our infantry into a single chanting mass before contact, producing a shock effect that has unnerved Byzantines, Sicilians, and French alike.

From the dynastic union of Aragon and the County of Barcelona in 1164, our Crown has built a Mediterranean commercial system anchored on Barcelona, Valencia, and Palma. The Consolat de Mar — the world's first standing maritime trade tribunal — adjudicates disputes from Pisa to Famagusta under Catalan law, and our consuls hold writ in every major port from Alexandria to Bruges. This commercial-legal infrastructure makes the Crown of Aragon the indispensable middleman between Italian banks, African gold, and Levantine spices.

cond.t: Only if you started as Aragon (ARA)

adv.d: Minted at Jaca since the first kings of Aragon, the dinero jaqués becomes the trusted coin of the kingdom, its silver content guarded by the Cortes against every royal temptation to debase it. A sound currency lets the crown borrow cheaply, the merchants reckon honestly, and the treasury may collect its revenues without the friction of clipped and doubtful coin. This monetary stability underwrites the kingdom's finances more reliably than any single tax.

The Almogavars, embracing new innovations, have undergone remarkable adaptations to enhance their efficiency on the battlefield. Integrating cutting-edge weaponry and strategic advancements into their traditional tactics, these formidable warriors have become even more formidable. With a blend of ancient expertise and modern tools, they stand as a prime example of the seamless fusion between tradition and innovation in warfare.

cond.t: Only if you started as Aragon (ARA)

adv.d: Our kingdom's standing executive — the Diputación del General — emerges from the Cortes of Monzón as a permanent commission that administers the general subsidio, defends the realm's fueros between Cortes sessions, and represents the four estates in continuous dialogue with the Crown. We will channel the kingdom's tax revenue through the Diputación's accounting offices, fund public works through its commissions, and lodge the noble houses' grievances in its standing chamber. This permanent institution gives our realm a parliamentary continuity and fiscal coordination that the Crown's other realms must rebuild from scratch each session.

Beyond the sea the Crown gathers a constellation of realms — Sicily won in 1282, Sardinia in 1324, and Naples under Alfonso el Magnánimo — each kept as a distinct kingdom under a viceroy rather than absorbed. We bind these realms to the dynasty with confirmed privileges, native magistracies, and a light hand on their liberties, so that their nobilities find more profit in loyalty than in revolt. This federation of overseas crowns yields the dynasty a steady tribute and a chain of Mediterranean bases no rival can easily prise loose.

cond.t: Only if you started as Aragon (ARA)

adv.d: The stony terraces of Cariñena and Campo de Borja, baked by the dry interior sun and swept by the cierzo wind, yield a dark, powerful wine prized far beyond the kingdom. Monastic cellars and town guilds expand the plantings across the Ebro depression, and the vintage travels by river and mule to the courts and garrisons of the crown. This robust viticulture turns thin upland soil into one of the inland kingdom's most valuable and durable exports.

Since forming the dynastic union with the County of Barcelona in 1164, the Crown has functioned as a composite monarchy in which each component realm — Aragon proper, Catalonia, Valencia, Mallorca, and Sardinia — preserves its own Corts, fueros, and currency. To strengthen central administration without abolishing these liberties, we will rationalize the chancery, standardize royal tax collection across the realms, and reinforce the office of the Lloctinent General, who governs in the absence of the king. This administrative consolidation lets the Crown coordinate war, taxation, and diplomacy with a speed that no other composite monarchy in Europe can match.

cond.t: Only if you started as Aragon (ARA)

adv.d: At Zaragoza rises the great baroque Basílica del Pilar, raised over the pillar where tradition holds the Virgin appeared to Saint James, drawing pilgrims from across the Spains. The crown endows its chapter, processes beneath its towers on the great feasts, and wraps its legitimacy in the most venerable Marian devotion of the peninsula. This sacral prestige binds clergy and commons to the dynasty and sanctifies the kingdom's rule as no mere law could.

Decades of campaigns from Lepanto to the Catalan Revolt have left thousands of widows, orphans, and crippled veterans of the Tercios de Aragón dependent on parish charity. The Crown will fund a system of Casas de Misericordia and orphanage workshops in Zaragoza, Valencia, and Barcelona, where the children of fallen soldiers receive food, schooling, and apprenticeships under royal patronage. This visible care for soldiers' families restores recruiting enthusiasm in towns that had grown weary of seeing their sons march off and never return.

The Valencian Fallas — annual neighborhood festivals built around enormous wood-and-papier-mâché monuments burned with fireworks on the feast of Saint Joseph — have produced an entire artisan class skilled in the handling of black powder, fuse mixing, and pyrotechnic timing. The same workshops that fabricate spectacular Saint Joseph crowns now produce ranging tables, fuze-set artillery shells, and the explosive bouquet rounds adopted by the royal arsenal. This festival-born expertise gives the Crown of Aragon a homegrown gunpowder-engineering tradition that mid-sized European powers must purchase from German or French specialists.

cond.t: Only if you started as Aragon (ARA)

adv.d: Zaragoza and the towns of the Ebro corridor fill with sugar refineries, flour mills, foundries, and rail workshops as the inland kingdom enters the industrial age. The Imperial Canal's water, the new lines linking the city to the Cantabrian coast and the Mediterranean, and a steady migration off the land feed a growing manufacturing economy. This industrial awakening lifts the once-agrarian heartland into a producing region rivaling the old coastal centers.

ref.d: The Crown of Aragon is a composite realm formed by several kingdoms and a principality, each with their own institutions and laws. As a trade and seafaring-oriented confederation, it represents extraordinary naval power, primed to dominate the Mediterranean with its fleets.

c.t: Is or was the country Aragon (ARA)
Is or was the country Spain (SPA)

ref.d: The Fuero is realized in written law, limiting royal power and ensuring the exercise of civil liberties. Only when new rulers swear to protect the Fueros are they recognized as such. The Fueros are the constitutions of the realm, subjecting power to the rule of law and expressing the balance of power between our state and our rulers.

c.t: Is or was the country Aragon (ARA)

items.name: Armenia
items.desc: The Armenian people are an ancient civilization, with a history beginning before even the time of the Romans. We have endured the rise and fall of conquering empires without losing either our mother tongue or our faith. Now we shall reunite the scattered heirs of Hayk under one banner and one Armenian identity!

adv.d: Our fortresses are a brilliant emblem of our resilience and fortitude, built to endure not only the difficult local climate, but also any foreign invader foolish enough to mount an attack into our unforgiving territory.

items.name: Austria
items.desc: From Wien, the house of Habsburg once held absolute power in the Holy Roman Empire, and the very core of that power was the Archduchy of Austria. Now that empire has long since turned to ash, and the time has come for us to reclaim the Archduchy and the seat of Imperial power!

adv.d: Our rise to power has made us the target of much envy, and the rival houses of the Holy Roman Empire vie for our position as the protectors of the south-eastern border. Despite these circumstances, we pride ourselves on executing diplomatic maneuvers unrivaled by any others.

The victory of Rudolf I over his rivals secured our place among the great houses of the Holy Roman Empire and is the subject of many tales and songs. The fervor displayed by him and his knights in the Battle on the Marchfeld will inspire our troops for centuries to come.
'Let others wage war; you, happy Austria, marry! For what Mars gives to others, Venus gives to you — kingdoms.'

c.t: Is or was the country Tyrol (TIR)
Is or was the country Austria (HAB)

adv.d: Our lands are at risk of invasion from hostile neighbors, who desire the riches of our valleys. Creating and funding an order of knights, ready to defend our lands, allows us to draw on greater forces if the need ever arises.
Our people are highly adapted to traverse the obstacles of our country, from the high peaks and passes of our mountains to the wide rivers of our valleys.

Given our location at the center of all Europe, we must adopt a highly flexible attitude towards external diplomacy. Alliances and rivals can shatter as easily as they are formed, and our diplomats must be trained to cover every possible position.
Only well-rounded tactics of artillery shock, cavalry charges, and unyielding infantry recruited from the landknechte can lead us to victory.

Maintaining our diplomatic relations requires time and effort, and committing too many people to diplomatic missions could negatively affect our efficiency and damage our reputation. The Austrian Court's streamlined approach ensures we deploy the right envoys at the right times and still gather the information we need without overextending our diplomatic resources.
A bit of bookkeeping will help us to weather any religious strife that could befall our realm. This harmless edict will surely not spark any further conflict.
The Geheimer Rat is an elite advisory body composed of high-ranking nobles and officials, serving as the central institution for guiding our political, military, and administrative decisions.
Our war council can only function with a proper bureaucratic structure. Only when we know every detail about our troops and logistics can we defend our realm from hostile intruders.

Defending our frontiers is a serious issue, and puts significant financial pressure on the state. The solution we have hit upon is to make generous grants of frontier lands in order to build up a professional military class. This will ensure more discipline overall and facilitate migration to the underpopulated regions of our realm.
Our rulers must receive the best education possible to live up to the ideal of the enlightened monarch.

Recruited from our Carpathian and Balkan lands, these light troops are well equipped to guard the peace in our border regions. Their knowledge of their homeland will make them a formidable opponent for any invader.
Stationed in border garrisons, these regiments of hussars will be able to patrol and secure the far reaches of our country, while keeping the strain on our treasury light.
The rapidly changing nature of warfare urges us to modernize our troops and tactics. In order to stay ahead of our foes, we shall make our artillery the pride of the Imperial army.
Austria is a diverse and multicultural realm, committed to embracing and accommodating its numerous ethnic minorities to maintain unity and stability amidst growing nationalist tensions.
Industrial modernization must always be a priority for our administration. Only through modern manufacturing can we compete with our rivals on a global stage.

Viennese Classicism is a transformative force in music. Our best composers' works shall revolutionize Western musical tradition through bold, trend-setting innovation of symphonic, operatic, and chamber arrangements.

ref.d: We have been granted the Privilegium Maius, which grants us an elevated position among the princes of the Holy Roman Empire. This shows our status and prestige even outside of Imperial lands, and elevates us to a higher position than that of a mere duke.

src.n: The Privilegium Maius in Our Hands

ref.d: The Reichshofrat serves as the highest legal institution for Austria and Holy Roman Empire both, giving us stronger control over the legal processes of both our direct and imperial subjects.

cond.t: Leader of organization: Holy Roman Empire

ref.d: Established by the state to clandestinely intercept and examine all correspondence, this Black Chamber will provide us with intelligence about the postal activity within our country. Our agents' expertise in stealthily opening, copying, and resealing official documents will become renowned throughout the world.

items.name: Ayutthaya
items.desc: A major trading hub with extensive foreign connections and a large population, the city of Ayutthaya will serve as a new source of power for the Thai, from which we can forge a path towards greater glory. As a united people, we will stand proudly against any who seek to breach our borders.

adv.d: Our country has a rich and complex literary tradition, from the epic Lilit poems narrating famous military conflicts, to the Nirat poetry of travels and lost lovers; from folk legend of local heroes to panegyrics praising the feats of our most glorious rulers.

Whether on horseback or atop an elephant, we can boast of an impressive cavalry, usually made up of descendants from the most prestigious families. Their contributions through supporting our infantry are invaluable.

The white elephant symbolizes sacred kingship in Buddhism tradition, and is also the emblem of our ruler. Possessing a white elephant legitimizes our authority, proving to our subjects that we rule with the blessing of the divine.

Rice has been grown in our country for centuries, but the constant flooding of our rivers has always been an issue for its proper cultivation. This new variety of rice, used to growing in flooded conditions, will provide us with a stable source of food even when the rivers overflow.
All freemen subject to phrai service not only serve in war — the Phrai Thaan — but also assist in the construction of public works, at the discretion of local governors.

All males at the age of eighteen are to be registered with the military, and their information passed on to the government bureaucracy. Every male citizen is eligible to be conscripted and made to serve in the army in war, and we will make sure that they do so if needed.

Our society is strictly organized along the Sakdina system. Each person knows their proper place in society and how much wealth and property they are entitled to have. This organization makes it much more efficient to extract taxes from them.

Our country is home to many people from afar, who came here hoping to profit from the richness of our land. Having so many people and goods flowing through our borders is something we derive numerous benefits from.

ref.d: Meaning 'Four Pillars', the Chatusadom ministry organization divides the government into two branches: the military, and civil affairs, the latter of which is further divided into four ministries. The compartmentalization and clear assignment of tasks to each makes for a more effective administration and serves as an extension of the ruler's authority.

items.name: Bahmanis
items.desc: For more than a century, we stood as the dominant Islam power in the south and controlled vast territories across the Deccan, but those splendid ancient cities were left in shambles long ago. Though internal strife and the rampant ambitions of provincial governors eventually split our realm into five successor sultanates, the time has come to restore the glory of the Bahmani people and unite the Deccan under a single, powerful rule.

items.name: Bavaria

c.t: Has estate privilege: Bavarian Land Division

items.desc: The once-lofty Duchy of Bavaria was a bastion of economic and diplomatic power, with its enviable location and gifted population. But despite its bright past, it now lies in pieces, divided and weak. We must reunite its former territories and reclaim the glories of the past if we wish to be more than a mere footnote in history!

adv.d: We have been granted the rulership of Bavaria directly by the Emperor! By embellishing ourselves as the divinely-appointed protectors of Bavaria, we will ensure our legitimacy cannot be questioned.

Our nobles have distinguished themselves as formidable knights in the service of the Holy Roman Empire. We should nurture and scrupulously maintain these troops to ensure the survival of our ducal integrity.

u.t: Chivalric order: Order of Saint Hubert

adv.d: The Hubertusorden will serve as a glorious reminder of our knights' combat prowess! Joining the order will be a reward for our loyal knights, and its members will display our glory for all to see.
Our lands are rich in the crops and fresh water required to brew beer, and our people readily enjoy this abundance. Many small breweries could grow into successful businesses, with the right support.

Our lands are frequently crossed by merchants wishing to trade Salt, Silver, and Livestock in the rich lands to our south. We would be foolish not to take advantage of their presence, and therefore will establish bustling trade hubs in our own lands to attract their business.

With our homeland at the feet of the beautiful Alps, we are a destination for artists from all over Europe, who seek inspiration in our incredible landscape. If we were to construct and support the appropriate cultural institutions, we could refine our court into a center of refinement and elegance, one that could rival even the most prestigious powers of Europe.
We once were ruled by Bavaria, unified in culture and allied under a single banner. We must ensure that the new Bavarian state is equally mighty, a home worthy of its strong and proud people.
Establishing a council with the sole duty of advising our ruler during times of conflict will help us develop a more capable fighting force.
We must ensure our people remain united in their faith, and that they will not be divided by heretical thoughts.
Only with a formidable standing army will we have the military might necessary to match our ambitions. With careful focus, we can expand it without having a ruinous impact on our state's finances.
Regiments of seasoned hunters and foresters. These units will be unmatched in forested terrain, able to hinder and harass our enemies if they dare to enter our forests.

No matter if we are answering to an Imperial overlord or cozying up to a potential foreign ally, our diplomats must be prepared for everything. But only if they keep Bavarian interests first and foremost in their efforts will we be able to claim true success in our diplomatic maneuverings.
Our realm needs a new standardized coin to serve as our national unified currency. Establishing a state-owned mint in our capital would ensure our total control over this new coinage.

The excellent quality of our beer has been celebrated for centuries, but for our brews to achieve legendary status, we must ensure their continued prestige and superiority for all time. Several rulers in the past have created regulations and standards for the brewing of this wonderful substance; and we could use this fact as a stamp of our breweries' quality.

items.name: Belgium
items.desc: The southern lands of the Low Countries are home to a people divided along linguistic and religious lines. But if we were to bring these squabbling groups together and have them working towards the goal of self-government, perhaps it would flatten the differences between us. To this end, we desire to declare ourselves a new and independent state.

items.name: Bohemia
items.desc: Ever since the Golden Bull of Sicily was granted to Ottokar I in 1212, the lands of Bohemia enjoyed an elevated status within Central Europe. With our control of the area, we will be able to reestablish the old title and align ourselves with the legacies of the old dynasties of Bohemia.

adv.d: Members of our royal dynasties are accustomed to journeys abroad. They have spent much of their upbringing as students of illustrious courts far away from home, in the pursuit of a thorough education in matters of statesmanship.
Our place within the Holy Roman Empire is one of prestige, grandeur, and authority. Few members wield as much soft power as us, due to our capable diplomats and alliance networks.

As part of our efforts to modernize Prague, we will issue grants encouraging prominent figures to relocate their business to the capital while offering privileges to attract skilled and wealthy foreign immigrants. This influx of talent and capital will transform our Prague into a thriving, cosmopolitan metropolis.

During the Hussite Wars, our armies relied on wagon forts called Wagenburg to win battles against superior forces. While we may not always deploy wagons, the principle remains: infantry sharpshooters fighting from prepared defensive positions become our standard doctrine.
There are very few workshops in the known world with the capacity to craft glass and crystal with the same quality and clarity as ours, let alone rival our superior production techniques.

Through the ravages of the Hussite Wars, and in an effort to safeguard our faith and people, we funded many fortified towns. Since then, we have gained great expertise in erecting fortifications and engineering impenetrable defenses.

For years, the standard currency in our country has been the groschen, a coin made of silver and used all throughout the Holy Roman Empire. The discovery of new sources of silver allows us to create another kind of bigger coin, the thaler, also called 'toler' or 'daler', which will become strong and influential enough to dominate all trade and become a new standard.

Through struggle and brotherhood, the adherents of our faith withstand all external conversion pressures. Our unshaken religious roots, stemming from ancient teachings, ring true to the hearts of all those who seek to protect their beliefs and live in peace alongside their fellow Christian faithful.
The nobility will always be rather sensitive about protecting their privileges. It would go far towards winning their loyalty if said privileges were to be guaranteed forever.

ref.d: The Commonwealth represents a reformed constitution of the …, giving more privileges and freedom to the various nations living within our borders.

items.name: Burgundy
items.desc: Back in the day, the Burgunds came down from Bornholm, settled in these lands, and gave them their name. As their descendants, our honor requires us to recreate that nation and govern these lands until the end of time.

items.name: Castile
items.desc: From the high meseta and the line of frontier castles that gave the kingdom its name, Castile has risen to become the foremost spear of the Christian Reconquista. By uniting the Castilian heartland under a single crown, we shall reaffirm Castile's dominion over the heart of Iberia.

cond.t: Only if you started as Castile (CAS)

adv.d: Castile takes its very name from the network of castillos — castles, fortresses, and watchtowers — that has crowned every defensible ridge along the Duero, the Tagus, and the Guadiana since the ninth-century repopulation of the Meseta. Strongholds like Burgos, Gormaz, Calatrava, and the dozens of keeps of the Castillos de la Frontera are raised, manned, and maintained by frontier councils (concejos) and the military orders of Santiago and Calatrava under royal charter. This centuries-deep tradition of fortification gives our Crown a fortress-keeping infrastructure that no other Iberian kingdom can sustain at the same scale.

The Camino de Santiago threads west across our realm from the Pyrenees through Burgos, Carrión, and León toward Compostela, carrying a ceaseless stream of pilgrims, friars, and foreign merchants along its hospices and bridges. The towns strung along the road grow fat on the pilgrim trade, their fueros drawing settlers to repopulate the meseta in the road's wake. This great artery of devotion and commerce fills our frontier towns with people and binds the Christian north into a single road of faith.

In the tradition of Alfonso X the Wise's Estoria de España, the royal chancery has long commissioned official chronicles of each reign, such as the Crónica de Alfonso XI, Pedro López de Ayala's accounts of the Trastámara civil wars, and Hernando del Pulgar's Crónica de los Reyes Católicos. By compiling these into a single dynastic history, we anchor every Castilian king to a continuous Visigothic and Reconquista lineage stretching back to Pelayo of Asturias. This royal historiography gives our dynasty an unbroken legitimacy that no rival house on the peninsula can claim.

cond.t: Only if you started as Castile (CAS)

adv.d: The hermandades — sworn brotherhoods of the Castilian towns — band their militias together to police the roads, hunt down bandits, and keep the king's peace where the crown's own officers cannot reach. Armed with crossbow and pike and answerable to their own elected alcaldes, these leagues field a standing rural constabulary that overawes unruly nobles and footpads alike. This brotherhood militia gives the realm a self-funding instrument of order that no purely feudal levy can match.

Inspired by the Moorish jinete, the Lanzas de Castilla ride lighter than a knightly lance but fight heavier than a skirmisher, closing to break a formation where a true light horseman would only harass and withdraw.

The royal Audiencias and Chancillerías — the high courts seated at Valladolid and later Granada — carry the king's justice into every corner of the realm, hearing appeals that once died in the courts of grasping lords. Their robed oidores, trained in Roman law at Salamanca, bind noble and commoner alike to a single royal jurisdiction. This apparatus of crown justice knits the kingdom together and strips the great houses of the legal independence that breeds revolt.

cond.t: Only if you started as Castile (CAS)

adv.d: Columbus's landfall and the Capitulations of Santa Fe have placed the lands and peoples beyond the Ocean Sea under the Crown of Castile. We will charter conquistadors and licensed colonists on the encomienda pattern, granting them rights over indigenous labor in exchange for evangelization and a fifth — the quinto real — of all metals struck from the new soil. This colonial framework gives Castile alone, of all European powers, an institutional template ready to absorb a hemisphere.

cond.t: Only if you started as Castile (CAS)

adv.d: The Armada Real musters the galleons and galleys of Cantabria, Andalusia, and Naples into a single royal fleet that escorts the treasure convoys and contests the seas from the Channel to the Levant. Our dockyards at Santander and the arsenals of the south build and refit the great ships, while a corps of trained crews man them through every campaign. This standing royal navy gives the historical Crown a blue-water reach that no breakaway successor could ever assemble.

The Servicio de Millones, first authorized by the Cortes of Castile after the disaster of the Armada, is an indirect excise on the four staples — wine, oil, vinegar, and meat — sold in the kingdom. Renewed every six years under negotiated terms with the eighteen voting cities, it bypasses noble and clerical tax exemptions by being levied on consumption rather than property ownership. This single reform nearly doubles ordinary Crown revenue at the moment of greatest fiscal strain, ideally sustaining the Habsburg war machine into the next century.

The Consejo de Castilla sits at the apex of the realm's government, a council of letrados that drafts the laws, supervises the courts and the treasury, and governs in the king's name when he is abroad or at war. Its committees and corregidores reach down into every city and province, turning royal will into administrative fact. This central council gives the Crown an instrument of governance whose reach and continuity no rival institution can match.

cond.t: Only if you started as Castile (CAS)

adv.d: Founded by Juan Manuel Fernández Pacheco, Marquis of Villena, on the model of the Académie française, the Real Academia Española takes as its motto Limpia, fija y da esplendor — to clean, fix, and give splendor to the Castilian tongue. Its first great project, the six-volume Diccionario de Autoridades, sets the standards of orthography, grammar, and usage that will bind together every Castilian writer from Cádiz to Lima. This institution makes our language the most regulated and exportable of the great European vernaculars, an instrument of empire as much as of letters.

cond.t: Only if you started as Castile (CAS)

adv.d: The royal arsenals and Reales Fábricas de Armas gather the realm's gunsmiths and founders into crown manufactories that arm the regiments to a single proofed standard. Cannon from the foundries, muskets from the workshops, and powder from the royal mills flow to the garrisons through a state-run ordnance system. This military-industrial backbone keeps the historical Crown's armies equipped at a scale and consistency that no successor state could improvise.

To break the dependence on foreign manufactures that drains American silver from the kingdom, the Bourbon kings are founding Reales Fábricas — state-owned manufactories producing luxury goods according to mercantilist principles. The Real Fábrica de Tapices of Madrid, the Real Fábrica de Cristales at La Granja, and the woolen manufactories of Guadalajara employ thousands under royal protection, with foreign masters imported to teach Flemish, Bohemian, and English techniques. This industrial program reverses the eighteenth-century trade deficit and seeds the manufacturing base from which a later industrial revolution can emerge.

ref.d: When the Kingdoms of Castile and León formed a definitive union in 1230, the Crown of Castile was born. Since then, the country has aimed to become the hegemonic power in Iberia, and one of the greatest and most prestigious nations in Europe.

c.t: Is or was the country Castile (CAS)
Is or was the country Spain (SPA)

ref.d: The Casa de Contratación is an agency that administers Spanish colonial operations. All voyages of exploration and trade must receive its approval, and it collects all colonial taxes. The Casa is also charged with safeguarding classified information about new trade routes and valuable discoveries.

Iberia is inhabited by a multitude of people with different faiths and beliefs. To force them to follow one or to expel those with different beliefs than the ruling class would be a grave mistake, and hurt our country more than it would do good. For us to achieve greatness, we must embrace this diversity.
The Royal Council of Castile is a centralized royal council to streamline taxation, justice, and administration under the direct oversight of the Crown.

c.t: Is or was the country Castile (CAS)
Is or was the country Spain (SPA)

src.n: Establish the Royal Council of Castile

ref.d: The Intendancy System is a new system of governance aimed at centralizing the authority of the Crown over that of the bureaucrats in order to oversee tax collection and implement anti-corruption measures.

src.n: Imposing the Intendancy System on the Colonies

ref.d: The Nueva Planta is a series of decrees and reforms formalized in order to abolish regional legal privileges and forge a single, unitary state under central authority.
Royal Factories are state-funded manufactories directly overseen by the Crown to produce strategic and luxury goods in support of mercantilist and centralized economic policies.

items.name: Catalonia
items.desc: The Principality of Catalonia, with its ancient liberties and the merchant fleets of Barcelona, has too long lived in the shadow of the Aragonese crown. By gathering the Catalan lands under our own banner, we shall at last become masters of our own destiny.

adv.d: The formal designation of our territory as Principatus Cathaloniae within the Crown of Aragon makes Catalonia not a mere county or appendage, but a sovereign principality with its own laws, currency, and Corts. The Count of Barcelona styles himself Princeps to underline the legal parity of our institutions with those of the Aragonese kingdom proper. This constitutional dignity raises the standing of our court before Christendom and binds our nobility to a project larger than any single comital house.

The Generalitat de Catalunya is a new institution emerging from the old Corts, with the Diputació del General established as the standing executive office that collects our realm's general taxes and represents the Corts between sessions. We will channel public revenue through the Generalitat's accounting system, issuing censals and violaris — perpetual and life annuities on Catalan tax revenue — at rates the older Genoese and Florentine houses cannot match for sovereign borrowers. This standing public-finance institution gives our Crown a stable revenue stream and a public debt market that no other peninsular realm can match.

The remença ties Catalan peasants to the land through the six Mals Usos — the 'evil customs' that bind serfs to their fiefs until they purchase their own freedom. Under reformed terms negotiated through the Sentence of Guadalupe, peasants gain proprietary rights over their plots while continuing to pay reduced dues, releasing rural labor and capital throughout the Principality. This agrarian settlement establishes a productive yeomanry in Catalonia decades before any other European kingdom resolves the lord-peasant question.

The Reapers' War — when the Catalan harvesters of the Corpus de Sang rose against the lodging of Castilian tercios and the violation of our constitutions — proved that our peasantry can muster a fighting force capable of holding the Principality against the largest army in Europe for nearly two decades. The folk song Els Segadors preserves the memory of that mobilization, and every Catalan child learns the verses from the cradle. This deep tradition of peasant-soldiery gives our Crown a manpower reserve that does not depend on professional recruiters or foreign mercenary captains.

The memory of our Principat Constitucionalista endures in legal manuscripts, civic statutes, and the patient scholarship of our jurists. Each generation copies the constitutions, debates them in the universities, and quietly extends their principles into municipal practice wherever the enforcers of these decrees do not look. This persistent constitutional memory tempers the centripetal pull of the court and gives every Catalan municipality a vocabulary of self-government that revolts and reforms can later draw upon.

Our literary and cultural revival — the Renaixença Catalana — restores Catalan to the printing press, the lecture hall, and the lyric stage after generations in which our language survived only in private correspondence and folk song. We will sponsor the restored Jocs Florals poetic competitions, fund the dictionaries and grammars that codify a modern literary standard, and bring our tongue back into the press, the academy, and the public administration. This cultural rebirth raises literacy among our subjects in their native language and binds every Catalan-speaking community into a single shared culture that no centralizing state can easily absorb.

items.name: Croatia
items.desc: The land of Croatia has been point of encounter between European West and East for centuries, between the waters of the Mediterranean and the many countries of the interior. Having been traversed by many peoples and cultures, it is under the Croatian identity that it will be able to flourish.

cond.t: Only if you started as Croatia (CRO)

adv.d: The cultural soul of Croatia is anchored in the 'Zvonimir tradition', where our history is carved in stone. We have promoted the memory of our independent kings through epic poetry and historical chronicles, instilling a 'Royal Consciousness' in every peasant and noble. This historical pride ensures that even when ruled by foreign kings, the Croatians view themselves as part of an ancient and sovereign nation, fostering a resilience that ensures our culture remains vibrant and resistant to external cultural decay.

This legal bedrock formalized the union between the Twelve Noble Tribes of Croatia and the Hungarian Crown. By preserving the right to elect the monarch and maintaining a separate coronation with the Zvonimir Crown, we ensure Croatia remains a distinct political entity in the case of falling in Union with other nations. This contractual sovereignty prevents total absorption into a foreign administration, allowing our nobility to manage internal justice and defense under their own ancient laws.

We look back to the glorious age of our native kings, such as Tomislav and Zvonimir, to inspire a sense of independent destiny and national pride. By tracing our lineage and institutions back to these sovereign rulers, we bolster our diplomatic standing among the courts of Europe and assert our right to a crown that is older than many of our neighbors'. This historical prestige commands respect from the Holy See and serves as a powerful unifying mythos that rallies the disparate regions of the kingdom under a single, storied banner of Romanic-Slavic royalty.

cond.t: Only if you started as Croatia (CRO)

adv.d: We have asserted the right of Monetaria, establishing a sovereign mint to produce the Banovac silver denar. By maintaining a higher silver content than neighboring currencies, our coin has become the primary medium of exchange in the northern Adriatic and the Drava basin. This fiscal independence allows us to fund its administration without relying on external subsidies, turning our court into a regional financial hub that attracts Ragusan and Venetian capital.

b: Damage Done versus Heathens in Battle: +10%
adv.d: Our cultural identity has been forged in the fire of the 'Century of Martyrs'. We have embraced the role of the Antemurale Christianitatis (Shield of Christendom), transforming our military struggle into a sacred religious mission. This mythos instills a deep, unshakable sense of historical duty in the population, viewing the defense of our nation as the defense of civilization itself. This 'Heroic Spirit' ensures that the national fire remains alive even in our darkest hours.

cond.t: Only if you started as Croatia (CRO)

adv.d: We have established one of the earliest and most daring printing houses in the Slavic world. By moving our technological heart to the 'impassable' valley of Kosinj, we ensure that the production of our sacred Glagolitic texts remains shielded from the maritime raids and border skirmishes that plague the littoral. This press is not merely a tool for literacy; it is a laboratory of cultural survival where we forge the first printed missals in our native tongue. By standardizing our ancient script through the modern press, we provide every parish in the Kingdom with a unified, incorruptible source of our laws and liturgy. This ensures that the Croatian identity remains intellectually fortified and spiritually independent, as it reaches the hands of every shepherd and noble, anchoring the soul of the nation in an unshakeable, home-grown tradition.

Founded by the invited Jesuit Order, this academy has evolved from a local gymnasium into the intellectual heart of our nation. By establishing a rigorous curriculum of Aristotelian philosophy, mathematics, and rhetoric, the academy has created a home-grown elite of 'Enlightened Croats' who are as comfortable in the salons of Vienna as they are in the Sabor. This institutional modernization ensures that our bureaucracy is led by a technocratic class capable of navigating the complex legal and scientific shifts of our century.

cond.t: Only if you started as Croatia (CRO)

adv.d: To counter the advance of our enemies, we have transformed our coastal fortresses into a sanctuary for the Uskoks — refugee warriors who wage a permanent war. These light-infantry units use small, fast boats to conduct lightning raids against enemy supply lines, surviving in the rugged karst where regular armies cannot follow. This policy turns our coast into a lethal 'no-man's-land' for our enemies, providing us with a cheap and fiercely motivated frontier guard that requires no support from the central treasury and keeps our enemies constantly on the defensive.

Our culture has embraced a dramatic and intense Baroque Catholicism, characterized by massive religious processions and the construction of grand, ornate churches. This 'Visual Piety' serves as a powerful unifying force, bridging the gap between the urban nobility and the rural peasantry through shared ritual and spectacle. This intense religious identity acts as a cultural shield against both Protestant and Eastern influences, ensuring that the Croatian soul remains firmly anchored in the Catholic-Mediterranean world, even while defending the central European plains.

cond.t: Only if you started as Croatia (CRO)

adv.d: To combat the sudden amphibious raids of enemy fleets or border transgressions, we will establish a sophisticated visual system using smoke and fire signals atop the highest Velebit crags. This 'Mountain Watch' will allow our forts to communicate across the jagged terrain in minutes, bypassing the slow mountain trails. By coordinating these signals with the inland garrisons, we will be able to mobilize our nation and reinforce our walls before any action happens. This high-altitude surveillance will turn the impassable peaks into a centralized command tower, ensuring that no enemy can approach without our immediate knowledge.

We have established the Consilium Regium in our capital, creating a dedicated executive government for the Croatian Nation. This body will act as a proto-ministry, handling the economy, education, and internal security of the Triune Kingdom. This era of 'Government by Council' will foster a professional class of Croatian civil servants who view the state as a rational, modern machine rather than a collection of feudal privileges. The experience gained in these halls of power will provide the administrative expertise necessary for the Croatian people to navigate the transition from a medieval kingdom to a modern European nation-state.

adv.n: Uniting the Coast and the Inner Lands

cond.t: Only if you started as Croatia (CRO)

adv.d: To break the isolation of our coast, we will oversee the monumental construction of numerous roads, linking the inland to our ports. This engineered highway will be carved through the limestone heart of the Velebit mountains, featuring advanced stone bridges and serpentine curves to accommodate heavy wagons. The road will transform our littoral from a desolate frontier into a vital economic artery, allowing the timber and grain of the interior to reach international markets. By physically binding the mountain hinterland to the Adriatic, we will complete the territorial integration of the nation, fostering a new age of trans-Velebit commerce.

items.name: Dahomey
items.desc: We have consolidated our territories and will now be able to establish a new country to resist foreign influences.

adv.d: Our ancient legends state that our royal line is descended from the union of a princess and a panther. This ancient and mystical tale will enhance our prestige and fame.
The Migan and the Mehu are the ruler's two chief ministers. One oversees the north, the other the south; one oversees justice, the other commerce. Together, they bring stability and prosperity.

A corp of female warriors, recruited from among the king's wives. They have earned their reputation as mythological Amazons due to their ferocity in battle and the fear they strike in the ranks of their opponents. These Dahomey Amazons are entirely devoted to Dahomey and its interests.
By secretly placing male courtiers disguised as royal wives in the harem, they will be able to act unseen as the king's eyes and ears, especially in matters of palace intrigue.

While raiding the surrounding territories, we obtain slaves who cannot only be employed economically or bartered to our neighbors, but who can serve in our armies. In this way, we will increase the number of fighters that can be called to arms.
As more and more foreigners are coming to our shores, we should establish a new office in our government to study and learn from their ways, so that we may benefit from this exchange of cultures.

Building a sprawling palace complex in our capital would be an elegant, yet imposing demonstration of our power. Any who may consider taking up arms against us will surely be deterred by the sight of our sumptuous palaces.

items.name: Dalriada

pot.t: Any primary, accepted or tolerated culture:

items.desc: The Gaelic peoples on the coasts around the Hebrides first united long ago, forming a kingdom famous for its seafaring culture and the strength of its fleet. We must claim this ancestral legacy and revive the kingdom.

items.name: Denmark
items.desc: Denmark, situated between the North Sea and Baltic Sea, is a country with great significance for Scandinavia. If we can control enough of its territory, we could reform it, and restore the legacy birthed by our forebears.

adv.d: Every part of our country is surrounded by the waters of the Baltic and North Seas. This gives us the unique advantage of being able to utilize waterways for both transport and communication, considerably shortening the time it takes to travel between regions.

Our domain is protected by natural barriers, namely the Jutland Peninsula and the Danish archipelago. This defensive geography is extremely helpful when we are under attack, as it gives us time to raise levies before our enemies can reach our core territory.

Denmark cannot rely on a vast population to supply their armies. Therefore, we need to ensure that mercenary companies are willing to serve our state, while guaranteeing their loyalty with solid contracts.

The rulers of Denmark have claimed overlordship over the Nordic regions for centuries. Embellishing the legacy of Kings like Canute 'the Great' will grant us the internal and external legitimacy needed to support our assertions.

Our country is surrounded by water, and therefore vulnerable to domination by any power with a large enough fleet. To ensure this will never happen, we must fund a navy capable of protecting our coastline and projecting our power over the north of Europe.

By establishing a separate department for our Treasury, the Rentekammeret, we will have better control over our finances and be able to run the government more efficiently. With the documentation of all our financial records, we will be able to estimate our future expenditures more easily, stabilizing our finances.
In the tumultuous religious landscape of Europe, we must set Denmark on the path to righteousness, and remain true to the doctrines of our church.

Our country has a long and proud history of shipbuilding. Our experienced shipwrights need a modern and spacious dock in which to construct a navy worthy of calling itself Danish. The waters around Copenhagen are the perfect place to construct such a dockyard.

While the Danish terrain is relatively poor in terms of rare materials available to exploit, they make up for it with agricultural abundance. We shall focus on optimizing our farming and food production, safeguarding our people against future periods of famine.

The regional laws of Jutland, Zealand and Scania formed the basis of our legal code for centuries. For the benefit of our realm, we should compile and unify these laws into a single comprehensive legal system, which will be known as the Danske Lov.
The Royal Life Guards are an elite Danish regiment that also serve as the ruler's personal guard and perform ceremonial duties.
The Scanian Regiment is a military unit composed of drafted peasants, established to reduce reliance on mercenary forces and build a more organized standing army under direct royal authority.

We cannot produce everything we need to maintain economic stability on our own. We must instead rely on a stable trade network to export our goods and import everything that we ourselves are not able to produce.

With the establishment of a centralized college to train our naval commanders, we will be able to produce skilled leaders familiar with our coastal waters. This will improve our marine defense strategy, and ultimately better safeguard Danish sovereignty.

items.name: England
items.desc: Trade has long been a foundation of English national policy. By extending our influence across borders and controlling its political development domestically, we have managed to become a major European power. Our colonial expansion is becoming a major factor in promoting our nation's economic growth, reinforcing our position in world affairs.

adv.d: The bravery and discipline of English foot soldiers has been witnessed from the shieldwalls of Northumbria to the darkened skies of France. Inspired by the lion-hearted spirit of our kings and the stoicism of the common man, our infantry fights with the ferocity of the Anglo-Saxon warriors before them.

The 'Great Charter' is a legal document that aims to protect the feudal rights of our barons against unjust taxation and legal maneuvers by the Crown. It is also one of the earliest documents to enshrine the idea of civil liberties, such as the right to a fair trial and protection from illegal imprisonment.

Our island protects us from outside enemies, but that will not matter if we do not protect the surrounding waters. By being true masters of our surrounding seas, we will keep a firm control on those who threaten our land.
The powerful martial longbow, originally deployed with great impact against armored English knights in the Welsh valleys, has been adopted into the military doctrine on either side of the border.
The Longbowmen excel not only due to their powerful warbow but also their years of training on the archery fields.

Beginning around 1495, the Tudor monarchy invested heavily in not just ships, but extensive infrastructure to maintain and otherwise support them. This for many marked the official founding of the Royal Navy.
Small innovations in equipment and organization result in continuous devastating volleys that shatter all but the most heavily armored formations.

The monarch has always had a secretary responsible for their royal correspondence. This position eventually evolved into that of the Secretary of State, a powerful minister who not only transmits royal decrees, but also has a high level of administrative authority.

The Eltham Ordinances represented England's first attempt to streamline royal bureaucracy and make it more adaptable and cost-effective. The Ordinances attempted reform through reducing royal household expenditures and consolidating certain bureaucratic functions.

Robert Blake has written several sets of rules and regulations that resulted in sweeping naval reforms. These include new tactics for blockades and landings, as well as adoption of the single line ahead battle formation.

The invention of coke smelting, specifically its application in Iron and Steel production, is closely tied to the Industrial Revolution. Iron and Steel are currently produced using traditional methods like charcoal smelting, whereas this new method will result in improved output and reduced maintenance costs.

A sweeping series of reforms limiting royal power, particularly in judicial matters. Among other stipulations, they state that the monarch may not unilaterally raise armies, prescribe cruel and unusual punishment, or interfere with the free election of members of Parliament.

The architectural innovations made by Inigo Jones will undoubtedly have a significant impact on future generations of architects. His promotion of classical architecture and his priority on proportion and harmony are considered hallmarks of the neoclassical movement in England.
These acts represent the apex of mercantilism. Trade must be conducted with our ships and pass through our ports first, where we will collect customs duties and any other applicable taxes.
This institution looked after the welfare of ordinary enlisted seamen in the Navy. It brought about a series of reforms that greatly improved the health of sailors on duty.

Elite marksmen equipped with the long-range Baker Rifle and trained to screen the main force in small independent pickets, Experimental Riflemen represent a modern vision of infantry combat formations.

Life in the English army is grueling and strictly regimented, but it instills in one a certain character. The unflappable nature of our troops, as well as their expertise with firearms, strikes fear into the hearts of our enemies.
A massive sea presence is required for any nation attempting to rule the waters. Our fleet will be so imposing that the shores of our enemies will always be surrounded by our vessels.
The water frame is a spinning frame used in the textile industry to produce cotton thread. This innovation will contribute to the establishment of large textile factories powered by water wheels.

ref.d: The 'Great Charter' is a legal document that aims to protect the feudal rights of our barons against unjust taxation and legal maneuvers by the Crown. It is also one of the earliest documents to enshrine the idea of civil liberties, such as the right to a fair trial and protection from illegal imprisonment.

c.t: Is or was the country England (ENG)

ref.d: The Benevolence Tax is a special tax that targets Nobility with ample savings or those living extravagantly, since they can more easily afford larger contributions. It correspondingly reduces the tax burden on the poorest members of society.

A commission of Nobility has effectively taken over the management of the kingdom, acting as regents. The monarch's ability to exercise power is limited, and their right to rule diminishes over time. The commission can only rule for as long as it retains the support of the parliament, or until such a time that the ruler amasses enough support to overthrow it.

cond.t: The Ruling Commission of England has been established
