franconian_wine_bottles.d: The bocksbeutel is a major part of our winemaking traditions. Being easily recognizable, the shape of this bottle serves as a sort of ambassador for the beautiful wines produced in our region, such as the Silvaner or Riesling. The exemplary talents of our glassmakers and winemakers will surely bring us economic advantages.

saxon_defensioner.d: The Defensioner are veteran troops from the rough lands on the Bohemian border. Tasked with securing the passes in the Ore Mountains, these units will serve us well in battles on rough terrain.

hesse_jager.d: Elite light troops composed of expert hunters. Their knowledge of our own terrain will increase our ability to fight in dense forests, although their equipment is not suited for prolonged fighting.

gebirgsschutzen_infantry.d: These mountain shooters are unmatched in traversing alpine terrain and besting our foes in the treacherous mountain passes. Their light equipment and loose organization makes them perfectly equipped for high-altitude combat.

Is or was the country Trebizond (TRE)

greek_group_the_spirit_of_resistance_adv.d: The fall of Constantinople at the hands of the crusaders was not the end of the Roman soul, but its crucible. Across the fragmented themes, a fierce Ethnos begins to coalesce, defined by a refusal to bow to the Latin Frankokratia. This defiance manifests as a spiritual and physical mobilization, where every village becomes a cell of resistance against the crusader lords. By clinging to our rites and language, we turn local skirmishes into a holy war for the restoration of our rightful heritage.

c.t: Is or was the country Byzantium (BYZ)
Is or was the country Trebizond (TRE)

greek_group_hesychast_traditions_advance.d: In an era of political decay, the spiritual movement of Hesychasm, championed by Grēgórios Palamâs, provides a profound inner strength. By focusing on the 'uncreated light' through silent prayer, our people find a unity that transcends failing borders and imperial intrigue. The monasteries of Mount Athos become the spiritual nerve centers of the Greek world, ensuring that neither the Pope's emissaries nor the Sultan's janissaries can break the religious cohesion of our populace.

c.t: Is or was the country Byzantium (BYZ)
Is or was the country Trebizond (TRE)

greek_group_stratioti_levies_advance.d: The rugged landscape of the Balkans has birthed a unique class of warrior: the Stratioti. These light cavalrymen, often wearing a mix of Byzantine armor and local attire, are masters of the 'hit and run' tactics necessary to harass larger, slower Western or Ottoman armies. Their reputation for ferocity and scouting excellence makes them indispensable, turning the tide of mountain battles where heavy knights flounder. They are the vanguard of a Greek military resurgence.

c.t: Is or was the country Byzantium (BYZ)
Is or was the country Trebizond (TRE)

greek_group_the_phanariote_network_advan.d: Within the narrow streets of the Phanar district, a new class of Greek merchant-diplomats has risen to prominence. Leveraging their literacy and linguistic skills, these families have made themselves indispensable to the administrative machinery of the Mediterranean powers. They serve as dragomans, governors, and financiers, creating a shadow empire of influence that spans from the Danube to the Nile. Their secret correspondence provides our state with unparalleled intelligence and diplomatic leverage.

c.t: Is or was the country Byzantium (BYZ)
Is or was the country Trebizond (TRE)

greek_group_aegean_coastal_defence_advan.d: The jagged coastlines and thousands of islands of the Aegean are our natural fortifications. We have transformed our maritime culture into a defensive doctrine, where every merchant vessel is armed and every fisherman is a potential marine. By patrolling the narrow straits and hidden coves, we ensure that any hostile fleet attempting to move through our waters is subjected to constant harassment. This decentralized naval power makes our maritime heartland nearly impossible to occupy.

c.t: Is or was the country Byzantium (BYZ)
Is or was the country Trebizond (TRE)

greek_group_the_modern_greek_enlightenme.d: The Diafotismós brings the fire of Western scientific inquiry back to the lands where philosophy was born. Greek intellectuals ship thousands of books back to the homeland, sparking a massive educational reform. This movement replaces old superstitions with the ideals of liberty, equality, and a renewed Hellenic identity. The resulting national awakening transforms our subjects into citizens, ready to fight for a modern, enlightened state.

wojewodztwo_advance.d: In the Polish Crown, the Wojewoda is a powerful magnate appointed by the king to administer a voivodeship and lead its regional sejmik. Holders of this dignity sit on the royal council and command significant influence over provincial affairs, often outshining the king's own reach in their lands.

rhaetian_the_vicinanza.d: The harsh environment in the Rhaetian and Dolomite Alps necessitated the development of the Vicinanza (Neighborhood). This is a system wherein the residents of a valley hold forests and high pastures in collective ownership. This culture of 'Mountain Democracy' prevents feudal lords from monopolizing the vital resources of the peaks, fostering a fierce localism that makes the Rhaeto-Romance valleys autonomous cells within larger empires.

rhaetian_the_tobia.d: The Rhaeto-Romance people have for a long time used the Tobià — a specialized wooden barn designed for long-term storage in high-altitude climates. These structures are often built with defensive features to protect the community's food supply. This culture of autarky ensures our people's survival during long winter blockades, as the population can retreat into the high valleys and subsist on stored reserves.

rhaetian_the_mountain_warriors.d: Under our guidance, the Rhaeto-Romance warriors will become world-renowned for their mastery of the halberd and the pike in broken terrain. Specialized in ambushing heavy cavalry in narrow gorges, these soldiers can turn their valleys into lethal traps. This military culture is so effective that Rhaeto-Romance mercenaries are highly sought after, bringing wealth and modern tactical knowledge back to their home mountains.

rhaetian_the_chanzun.d: More than ever, the Rhaeto-Romance people need to utilize epic songs (Chanzuns) and oral poetry to preserve their distinct language and history. This creates a culture of 'Linguistic Defiance', where their Latin-based speech is used to foster an identity that is neither German nor Italian. This cultural pride ensures the valleys remain unified against external administrative overhauls.

rhaetian_the_alpine_diplomacy.d: We control the strategic mountain passes that cross the Alps. This tends to attract unwanted attention from other nations who want that same control. Out of this chaos, a specialized class of Rhaeto-Romance diplomats may emerge. Under our sponsorship, these multilingual negotiators will master the art of playing major powers against each other to maintain local autonomy. This culture of high-stakes mediation will ensure that even when foreign armies occupy the valleys, the legal and social sovereignty of the communes remains intact through meticulously drafted treaties.

rhaetian_the_national_revival.d: Our intellectuals have begun the formal revival of our languages, for too long considered 'inferior' to other Latin tongues. Under our guidance, the scholars will codify dialects into literary standards and publish national histories. This will create a solid basis for our language, ensuring that the Rhaeto-Romance people are integrated into modern states as an equal and respected nation.

wallachian_tradition.d: According to historical tradition, Radu Negru crossed the Carpathians from Transylvania to found the Principality of Wallachia, and similar stories have been told about the foundation of other Principalities. This 'founding descent' or Descălecatul represents the migration of Romanian elites and the establishment of the first sovereign Țara Românească (Romanian Land), independent of foreign hegemonies. This event marks the birth of a distinct Romanian statehood, separate from the surrounding empires, but deeply rooted in Orthodox and Latin heritage.

mol_the_moldavian_road.d: By securing the 'Moldavian Road' connecting the Baltic Sea to the Black Sea, we have positioned our main settlements as vital hubs for the Northern European fur and wax trades. We have granted extensive privileges to Slavic merchants and German burghers to settle in our customs towns, ensuring that every caravan passing from the Baltic to the Genoese ports of the south pays a heavy toll into our treasury. This commercial wealth allows us to fund a professional court and to build stone fortifications without taxing our free peasantry into rebellion.

tra_the_transylvanian_autonomy.d: While Transylvania has remained part of the Hungarian Kingdom, the local Romanian, Saxon, and Hungarian nobles have all maintained a unique degree of regional autonomy under their own Voivode, and lived in peace. This shared governance has allowed everyone to preserve their distinct faiths and customs despite their apparent differences. This internal collaboration has ensured a certain degree of internal peace and multiculturalism in the Carpathian interior.

wallachian_heritage.d: In 1330, Basarab I defeated the Hungarian King Charles Robert, securing Wallachian independence through superior mountain tactics. This victory proved that a smaller, localized force could utilize the treacherous Carpathian passes to dismantle imperial armies, setting a military precedent for the next five centuries. Our troops are now experts in hit-and-run warfare and utilize the terrain to bleed invaders long before they reach the Danubian plains.

romanian_the_foundation_of_the_voivodesh.n: The Foundation of the Voivodeship Tradition
romanian_the_foundation_of_the_voivodesh.d: The transition from tribal knezes to the centralized office of the Voivode signals the maturation of Romanian political culture into a sophisticated medieval system. This Dux or military leader model is adapted from both Slavic and Byzantine influences but is uniquely Romanian in its execution, blending elective monarchy with dynastic continuity. It will provide the community with a clear military hierarchy capable of negotiating with the neighboring crowns as sovereign equals.

mol_the_banner_of_the_golden_bull.n: The Banner of the Golden Bull
mol_the_banner_of_the_golden_bull.d: Under the banner of the Golden Bull, representing our nation, Moldavia will become the 'Bulwark of the East', successfully defending against enemy incursions. We will start a tradition of building a monastery for every military victory that will create a landscape of religious sites. This fusion of religious zeal and military discipline ensures our soldiers fight with the conviction of crusaders.

tra_unio_trium_nationum.d: In response to threats of peasant revolts, our higher classes have formed the 'Union of the Three Nations'. This complex and rigid legal framework largely excludes the commoner majority, but creates a highly stable, fortified, and loyal administrative core for the region. This internal unity provides the crown with a reliable base of professional urban and feudal soldiers.

boyar_regime.d: The formalization of the Princely Chancellery allows for the systematic recording of land grants and diplomatic treaties in Church Slavonic and, eventually, Romanian. This bureaucratic evolution will enable the Voivodes to more efficiently tax the rural peasantry and maintain a permanent corps of diplomatic envoys at the courts of Europe. It will mark the transition from a tribal military society to a sophisticated medieval state.

romanian_the_letter_of_neacsu.d: The Letter of Neacșu of Câmpulung represents the earliest surviving document in the Romanian language. This shift from Slavonic to the vernacular in private and administrative correspondence signals a growing national self-awareness among the elites and merchants. It provides the foundation for a unified Romanian literary culture that will eventually bridge our lands.

mol_the_great_military_reforms.d: To counter the numbers of our enemies, we have reorganized our army into the Oastea Mare (The Great Army). By granting land to the Răzeși — free-holding peasants who owe service directly to the Voivode — we have created a loyal, self-equipped infantry core that fights with the ferocity of landowners defending their own soil. This system ensures that even when the boyars waver, the Prince has a reliable and massive pool of battle-hardened soldiers.

tra_the_transylvanian_trade_guilds.d: In the bustling cities of the Carpathian arc, merchants from our main cultural groups have begun to organize themselves into trade guilds and fraternities, often in competition or cooperation with the others. This is urbanizing a segment of the population, creating a middle class who funds schools and prints books. This economic rise will allow our nation to move beyond the village and into the marketplace of ideas and global commerce.

wal_the_order_of_the_dragon_influence.n: The Order of the Dragon Influence
wal_the_order_of_the_dragon_influence.d: We will introduce a culture of brutal psychological warfare and absolute law and order in Wallachia. By purging the corrupt boyars and imposing strict legal codes, we will consolidate princely power and transform the military into a centralized force loyal only to the Voivode. This ruthless reputation will serve as a primary deterrent for the forces of our enemies.

romanian_the_postelnic_bureaucracy.d: We have modernized our central administration by expanding the role of the Postelnic (Great Chamberlain) to oversee a professionalized corps of diplomatic and financial scribes. By adopting Western-style chancery practices and keeping rigorous records of state revenues and foreign treaties, we have moved beyond simple feudal governance. This bureaucratic efficiency allows the Voivode to squeeze every ducat out of the Danubian trade while maintaining a complex network of spies in our enemies' capitals.

mol_the_chronicles_of_grigore_ureche.d: A transformative era of intellectual self-awareness has dawned! Our high boyars have begun to systematically document the history of our people in our native Romanian for the first time. By scientifically documenting the Latin origins and linguistic heritage we share with our Romanian brothers, we shift the state's foundation from a purely religious identity to a modern linguistic and historical one. This cultural awakening strengthens the internal legitimacy of the Prince and provides our diplomats with the historical arguments needed to assert our sovereignty among the European courts. History has become a weapon of the state.

tra_the_edict_of_torda.d: In a Europe increasingly torn apart by bloody and fanatical religious wars, Transylvania has bravely issued the Edict of Torda, the first law of universal religious tolerance in the Western world. By allowing Catholics, Lutherans, Calvinists, and Unitarians to coexist within a single legal framework, we have prevented the internal social collapse and civil strife seen throughout the Holy Roman Empire. This unprecedented religious peace makes our principality a safe haven for displaced scholars, scientists, and merchants, rapidly accelerating our adoption of modern administrative reforms and diverse cultural influences. Tolerance has become our greatest strategic asset.

cunning_diplomacy.d: Under the visionary leadership of our rulers, we will achieve the geopolitical impossible: the unification of all Romanian lands under a single banner. This 'Great Idea' will ignite a latent national consciousness that will transcend ancient feudal borders, proving to the world that a unified Dacia can stand as a European Great Power in its own right. This vision will set the legal, military, and symbolic precedents that will provide us with a permanent, historical claim to regional hegemony and the eventual gathering of all Romanians.

romanian_the_romanian_renaissance.d: Due to the influence of our wealthiest families, our lands are undergoing a cultural blossoming known as the Brâncovenesc style, which we must support. This period of high culture will lead to the construction of grand palaces and the patronage of humanist scholars who will emphasize the Roman origins of the Romanian people. This intellectual movement will solidify our identity as the 'Latin island' in a sea of Slavic and Magyar influences, boosting our diplomatic standing in Western Europe.

mol_the_moldovan_enlightment.d: Dimitrie Cantemir has ascended to become a polymath of European renown, bringing the radical principles of the early Enlightenment directly into our court. By mapping the intricate history, music, and geography of our region for a Western audience, we have gained a profound strategic advantage in the shifting sands of Eastern European politics. We have transitioned from a medieval frontier march into a scientifically managed state that looks increasingly toward the modernized reforms of the West for its political and military inspiration. Knowledge is the new currency of the Moldavian throne.

tra_the_vauban_transylvanian_bastion_syn.d: As the age of gunpowder reaches its peak, we have adopted a unique school of military architecture that adapts the latest Italian and French Trace Italienne designs to the rugged, limestone geography of the Carpathian interior. Our major administrative centers have been refortified with low-profile, angled bastions capable of absorbing heavy siege artillery fire. Unlike the massive stone walls of the past, these modern earth-and-brick works are designed for active defense, featuring interlocking fields of fire for the principality's growing artillery corps. This defensive doctrine ensures that any invading army is bled dry in a series of prolonged, costly sieges before they can ever threaten the state's heartland.

wal_the_diplomat_schools.d: Under the patronage of high officials, we have established the Princely Academy of Saint Sabbas, bringing Italian and Greek professors to our capital. This investment in high education has created a generation of 'Philosopher-Diplomats' who are as comfortable discussing Latin rhetoric as they are negotiating secret treaties with our neighbors. By turning our capital into an intellectual beacon, we have ensured that our administrative elite remains the most sophisticated in the Balkans, capable of outmaneuvering anyone at every turn.

romanian_the_scoala_ardeleana.d: This intellectual movement born in Transylvania has successfully combined Enlightenment rationalism with a fierce national pride, proving the Latin origins of our people through rigorous cultural and linguistic studies. By creating the first modern Romanian grammar and history books, we have provided the ideological fuel for a true nationalistic spirit. The school has convinced the Romanian people across all provinces that they are a single, Western-descended nation destined for sovereignty, effectively ending the era of medieval provincialism.

mol_the_cotnari_and_odobesti_wines.d: Vineyards have remained Moldavia's greatest treasure, with the sweet white wines of Cotnari rivaling Tokay in the courts of Europe. We have already codified the first wine classifications, establishing a state interest in the export of 'Perle de la Moldavie'; now it is time to pass to action. This luxury trade will provide the Princely court with significant hard currency from neighboring markets, funding the lavish palaces in our capital.

tra_the_national_mining_academy.d: We have established world-class scientific institutions to oversee the intensive extraction of gold, silver, and salt from the multiple mountain ranges of our nation. By applying the latest mineralogical and chemical techniques, we have turned Transylvania into the primary treasury of the region. This industrial focus has created a new class of professional engineers and technocrats who manage the state's resources with scientific precision, ensuring long-term economic stability.

wal_the_abolition_of_serfdom.d: Under the reformists in our nation, we have taken the radical step of legally abolishing serfdom, before many of our neighbors. By transforming the peasantry from 'chattel' into 'taxable subjects', we have centralized the state's fiscal power and broken the absolute control of the rural boyars. This social revolution provides the Voivode with a more direct relationship with the people, creating a more mobile and economically active population capable of supporting a modernizing central administration.

guj_hub_of_the_indian_ocean_trade.n: Hub of the Indian Ocean Trade
guj_hub_of_the_indian_ocean_trade.d: Due to the nature of the monsoon tradewinds and its specific location, Gujarat has long served as the hub of the East-West trade in the Indian Ocean, connecting the Red Sea, Egypt, and Malacca. Due to this, Gujarat merchants were important middlemen bringing such precious goods as spices from the Maluku Islands and Silk from China, and then selling them to the merchants coming from the west.

guj_garba.d: Originating out of the worship dances done by women in praise of the Hindu goddess Ambaji, our people have refined a new and very graceful form of dance called the Garba. The basics of the dance are singing and clapping rhythmically in a circular formation. Today, our men and women use this dance to celebrate any occasion with great fervor, coming together as a community and wearing exquisitely embroidered outfits. All of us together, young and old, peasant and prince, Muslim and Hindu, dancing in an ever-growing circle.

req: Hub of the Indian Ocean Trade
guj_jain_routes.d: Jainism is an ancient way of life, shaped into its current form by Mahavira. For a thousand years, Gujarat has been the stronghold of the Jain community and faith, with many holy sites and temples. Royal dynasties have patronized the religion, forming a community with the Hindu people. Muslim invasions from the west by Mahmud Ghazni and Mohammad Ghori, oppressed the Jain community, vandalizing temples or converting them into mosques, as well as burning Jain libraries. However, the Jain people of Gujarat have survived, adapted, and prospered, using their connections with Jain communities across the world to serve as a hub for both faith and commerce.

guj_gujarati_lipi.d: The Gujarati Lipi is a new script and writing system developed by mercantile interests. Also known as the saraphi (bankers), vaniasai (merchants), or mahajani (traders) script due to its association with commerce, its use has rapidly become widespread throughout Gujarat, Kutch, and Sindh for writing regional languages and studying Sanskrit. The Zoroastrianism community has also adopted it as a writing system for Avestan. This common writing system unites diverse communities, facilitating both practical communication and a common identity.

guj_gujarati_merchant_diaspora.d: Our people trade on every shore, pursuing commerce and following the trade winds. Our fleets sail constantly in pursuit of new opportunities, and our merchants understand both the craft of shipbuilding and the value of building good, hardy ships on a limited budget.

hassaniya_maqil_migrations.d: The Banū Ḥassān and the wider Banū Ma'qil Arab clans push west out of upper Egypt across generations, mingling with the Sanhaja Berbers of the western Sahara and imposing their Arabic dialect, our Ḥassāniyya, on the conquered camps. Our shayḵs adopt the genealogies of the incoming Arabs, our scholars trace the line of every ruling family back to Banū Ḥassān founders, and the older Berber tongues retreat into a substratum of vocabulary preserved only in pasture-songs and place-names. This Arab-Berber synthesis gives the Bidhan a tribal-genealogical framework that binds the western Sahara into a single cultural sphere shared with no neighboring people.

hassaniya_azalai_salt_caravans.d: The great twice-yearly azalai caravans assemble at the Wadan rendezvous and run south to Walata and the Niger bend, hauling slabs of rock-salt cut from the western Saharan quarries of Ijil and the sabḵa of Ijil down to the gold-and-grain markets of Mali and Songhai. Our caravan-masters hold hereditary leases on each salt source, our pack-camels marshal in their hundreds for the southbound run, and our return convoys carry Sudanese gold-dust, Hausa cloth, and kola nuts back to the northern entrepôts. This salt-for-gold cycle, anchored at the western Saharan source, gives the Bidhan treasury a mineral-revenue stream that no neighboring economy can substitute for from local rock.

hassaniya_mehari_warbands.d: The mehari (the tall, white, riding camel of the Sahara) carry our Hassan warbands four hundred kilometers in three days across terrain that no horse-cavalry could traverse, striking caravans, settled enemies, and rival tribes before any retaliation can be organized. Our young warriors train from boyhood on these animals, learning to ride in line for the desert charge, fire bows from the saddle, and disperse into the dunes when pursuit appears. This camel-borne raiding tradition gives the Bidhan a strategic mobility that no neighboring military system, Maghrebi, Sudanese, or Saharan, can match in our home terrain.

hassaniya_sharr_bubba.d: The Šarr Bubba, the long struggle that finally separates the Hassan warrior tribes from the Zawaya scholarly tribes, ends in a binding caste-line truce that each side accepts as the price of an end to the slaughter. The Hassan retain the monopoly on bearing arms and collecting tribute; the Zawaya retain the monopoly on Quranic teaching, judicial mediation, and inter-clan diplomacy; the tributary Lahma and freedmen Haratin accept their settled stations under both. This formal caste settlement gives our Bidhan society an internal stability and a division-of-labor clarity that no inter-clan feuding can readily reignite.

hassaniya_qadiriyya_tariqa.d: The Qādiriyya tariqa, the elder Sufi brotherhood of the western Sahara transmitted through the Kunta scholarly lineages and the great zawaya of Wadan, Shinqit, and Walata, anchors the moral and judicial authority of the Bidhan religious caste from the Atlantic coast to the Niger bend. Its silsila of initiation binds Quranic scholars across tribal lines, its lodges mediate the inter-clan disputes that no warrior could settle by force, and its loyalty oaths bind subordinate tribes to their patron zawaya. This entrenched Sufi infrastructure gives the Bidhan polities a religious legitimacy and a personal-loyalty network that no later brotherhood can readily displace.

hassaniya_shinqit_libraries.d: The manuscript libraries of Shinqit, Wadan, Tichitt, and Walata, preserved by the great scholar-families of the western Sahara, catalog tens of thousands of volumes in Mālikī jurisprudence, Maghrebi grammar, classical Arabic poetry, Sufi mystical commentary, and the local genealogies of every Bidhan clan. Our manuscript-copyists train new generations in the cursive Saharan script, our binders preserve the older codices in tooled leather, and our scholar-merchants ship duplicates to libraries in Cairo, Fez, and Tunis. This concentrated manuscript culture gives the western Sahara a textual-scholarly reputation — the Bilād Shinqīṭ — that no Atlantic settler society can replicate from imported books alone.

haudenosaunee_tradition.d: The legendary Hiawatha, renowned among the Haudenosaunee people as a great speaker and leader, has set a very high precedent for what a diplomat should be. We will honor him by following his example in our diplomatic relations.

haudenosaunee_heritage.d: It would be a mistake for our enemies to regard us as weak based on our diplomatic strength. Our warriors are as fierce and proud as those from any militaristic society, and underestimating them is the leading cause of death among our rivals.

tree_of_peace.d: The Tree of Peace is the legacy of the Great Peacemaker, and is a symbol of our commitment to unity among the different tribes, as well as a representation of the chiefs themselves.

kainerekowa.d: We must always honor the work of Hiawatha and the Great Peacemaker, the Great Law of Peace, which united our five nations under a single purpose, and gave us our rules of governance.

mourning_wars.d: It is a long-established tradition of our people to adopt captured warriors into our tribe. But to replenish our numbers and ensure our defensive and offensive strength, we should seek to adopt entire tribes into the Haudenosaunee, not just individual fighters.

haudenosaunee_present_giving.d: The basis of our trade interactions is represented in the form of gift exchanges. As our people come together and work for the benefit of the whole, the act of gifting is guaranteed to be followed by another gift in return.

warriors_unity.d: We may not be the largest tribe in terms of sheer number, but our tribal nature gives us something that others lack: unity! Our warriors fight as brothers and stand together on the field of battle. So long as we maintain this tradition, we cannot lose!

captives_in_war.d: We fight wars mainly to take captives, which replace our own losses. However, not all those captives need to be adopted into our tribe, and some can be used for labor instead.

haudenosaunee_ambition.d: The Haudenosaunee Confederacy has become a model for success. All nations around us are awestruck by our excellent rulership!

swiss_eternal_alliance.n: Eternal Alliance of the Forest Cantons

c.t: Is or was the country Uri (URI)
Is or was the country Schwyz (SYZ)
Is or was the country Obwalden (OBW)

swiss_eternal_alliance.d: We have forged an eternal alliance with our friends in the neighboring Cantons. Had it not been for this treaty, we would have surely succumbed to the Habsburg invaders and fallen under the rule of foreign tyrants yet again. These alliances will ensure our survival for centuries to come.

paik_system_advance.d: The Paik System is a corvée labor system where capable adults, the so-called Paiks, are obligated to serve in the state militia in exchange for farmland.

samanta_advance.d: Sāmanta — neighbor — is a term denoting vassals and tributary chiefs alike. It is a feudal system that has for centuries acted as one of the pillars of our society. While this arrangement is currently losing prominence, it remains a foundation of our political structure.

kalaripayattu_advance.d: Kalaripayattu — the Practice in the Arts of the Battlefield — is an old Indian martial art with its origins in the Malabar. Warriors of our state shall be trained in the arts of Kalaripayattu to ensure their hand-to-hand and melee prowess.

paik_regiments_advance.d: Paiks are foot soldiers of India who are renowned for their offensive and defensive versatility and their skill in archery.

advanced_paik_system_advance.d: Paiks are foot soldiers of India who are renowned for their offensive and defensive versatility and their skill in archery. As the weapons develop, so does their portfolio of skills. Thus, the bows of the early eras have been replaced by the modern musket, yet their versatility still prevails.

celtic_raiders_advance.d: For millennia, our ferocious and agile guerilla warfare has harried our foes, besting them with a devastating succession of evasive skirmishing and blood-curdling charges.

irish_booleying_advance.d: In Ireland, cattle-rearing is our way of life. The noble bovine is not only a source of food, but a symbol of wealth. By booleying, a system of moving our herds from one distant pasture to another, we can grow that wealth.

irish_monastacism_advance.d: Although we are now aligned with Roman Catholic practices in principle, religious life in our islands still puts a great focus on lay clergy.

irish_travelling_bards_advance.d: Traditional poets trained in courtly ways crisscross our lands looking for some likely lord to hire them.

hiberno_norman_keeps_advance.d: Our Norman forebears built splendid towers to maintain their grip on the hostile interior of Ireland.

irish_frontier_settlement_advance.d: The land we have seized from the Irish is ripe for exploitation. We just need to ensure that only the right sort of people migrate here to settle these cheap crofts.

jap_bushido.d: Although never formally codified into specific rules, the way a warrior should behave is clear: A warrior's duty is to fight and win in battle, and to expand the glory of one's own clan, regardless of the methods needed to achieve that.

jap_land_of_the_rising_sun.d: Japan has a long and glorious history. Our unique cultural traditions, our brave soldiers, and our unconquerable geography make us stronger than many other states in our region. The time has come for the Land of the Rising Sun to take its place among the great nations of this world!

jap_ancestral_legacy.d: The ancestral lineage of our clan is well-known, and our reputation is a pillar of our identity — one that we strive at all costs to uphold, as our history both defines us and ensures our right to rule.

jap_shinobi.d: Information is key to gaining the advantage in any situation. To that effect, we have long since used spies and infiltrators to gather reconnaissance. These Shinobi no Mono are usually from the samurai class, although they can also be recruited from the local peasant population, and are sent into enemy territory, where they blend in and establish networks of informants.

jap_head_hunting.d: The achievements of a warrior in battle are only truly noteworthy if they can be proven. To that end, samurai will collect the decapitated heads of enemies they have slain to present them later to their general. The more numerous and more important the heads that a samurai takes, the better the rewards he will receive.

jap_ichiban_yari.d: Drawing first blood in battle is an honor and a good omen, and thus our warriors are eager to land the first strike whenever they have the opportunity to do so.

jap_ashigaru.d: Warfare has always been the domain of the mighty samurai. Recent developments, however, have proved the need for more substantial reinforcements, and thus our battlefields now also include peasant troops. These ashigaru will not be just common rabble, however, as their rigorous training and ample battle experience makes them formidable fighters, on equal footing with the samurai.

jap_daiku_construction.d: Traditional carpentry techniques, or daiku have been used in Japan since the earliest days of our history. Our wooden buildings are resilient yet flexible, and admired by many for their beauty and skillful construction. From the lowliest hut to the most elaborate palace, wood is our most universal building resource.

jap_wandering_ronin.d: It is fairly common for samurai to wander the country in search of the best employment opportunities, switching their allegiance to whoever pays them the most. These warriors come and go like the errant waves, but we can always make use of them.

jap_reformed_land_holding.d: Traditionally, we assessed land value based on size, but this failed to take into account that not all land is the same. From now on, it will be valued according to how much Rice can be grown there. This will streamline related economic actions and make it easier to get the best outcomes from our agricultural ventures.

jap_jokamachi.d: Turbulent times are gravely dangerous for our people, so for safety, they tend to settle around the security of fortified places. These huddles eventually turn into cities, which of course provide commercial and cultural assets in addition to physical protection for those who huddle behind the walls.

jap_terakoya.d: These private schools provide basic education to commoners, promoting literacy, numeracy, and moral values. Terakoya play a vital role in fostering a more educated and socially aware populace, contributing to national stability and progress.

jap_codified_bushido.d: The expected behavior of a warrior is becoming increasingly idealized, with values such as honor and loyalty being given more importance than their actual utility in real battle. This romanticized and codified version of Bushidō, however, will improve how our armies are perceived, even if it is not how they actually behave.

jewish_group_diaspora_firms.d: Our merchant families maintain commercial partnerships that span the diaspora — branch offices in Fustat, Aden, Mahdia, and Lucena exchange letters of credit, agency contracts, and family-firm capital across regions that few non-Jewish merchants traverse. Trust is anchored in kinship, marriage, and shared customary commercial law; our partners in distant cities know one another's signatures and seals. This kinship-based trade infrastructure gives our crown a commercial reach the rain-fed agricultural economies cannot match through formal contracts alone.

jewish_group_court_physicians.d: Our physicians serve at host courts from Iberia to Yemen to Malabar — Jewish-educated medical specialists holding court patents as private doctors to sultans, kings, and emperors. Their offices come bundled with diplomatic missions, court ceremonies, and influence over royal succession crises that no purely-mercantile minority could secure. This medical-elite niche gives our crown ready access to foreign-court inner councils and a steady channel of high-court information.

jewish_group_hidden_communities.d: Our communities have learned to wear the religion of our host states publicly while preserving family ties, professional networks, and customary practices in private — Iberian conversos, Persian Mashhadi families, Mallorcan Chuetas, and the assimilated Kaifeng households maintain household kinship and trade-firm relationships across what should be a religious divide. Inquisitorial pressure rarely succeeds at severing these communal connections because they are anchored in marriage, partnership, and oral memory rather than in any institution the state can dismantle. This hidden-community resilience gives our crown a population that resists external destabilization and an internal cohesion that no purely-public minority can supply.

jewish_group_maritime_diaspora.d: Our merchant houses follow the sea-routes of every Jewish-cultural reach — Sephardim along the Atlantic corridors, Mustaarabi across Levantine ports, Cochini along the Malabar spice run, Teimani through the Red Sea, Salonican families through the Adriatic. Our ships' captains may be of any host culture, but the bills of exchange, shipping contracts, and warehouse keepers at every major port are members of our family-firm network. This maritime-network specialization gives our crown a trade-route reach across every navigable basin that no single-region commercial power can replicate.

jewish_group_court_financiers.d: Our family-firms serve the absolutist courts of multiple empires — Habsburg Hofjuden financing Imperial armies, Ottoman court agents brokering loans for sultans, Malabar merchants funding regional rajas, Persian-era financiers managing royal mint contracts. These positions are precarious yet enormously lucrative — one provider supplies grain and powder for an entire campaign season, the next handles the royal treasury through a single intermediary. This high-finance court role gives our crown leverage at the heart of host-state administration that no purely-mercantile family-firm can match.

jewish_group_civic_emancipation.d: Our community status transforms across the modern era as host states extend civic rights to their Jewish populations — the revolutionary French emancipation decrees, Habsburg patents of toleration, Ottoman Tanzimat reforms, and the gradual liberalization of the British and Russian regimes. The old corporate-minority status — chartered quarters, ghetto walls, restricted professions, communal taxes — gives way to individual citizenship and open access to education, the bar, the medical schools, and the civil service. This civic transformation gives our crown a Jewish population pulled into the modern professional classes rather than confined to historical occupational niches.

mounted_people.d: Our people have thrived on horseback for centuries, and these majestic creatures are an integral part of our culture and power. We take immense pride in our unrivalled skills in our equine husbandry and talent for mounted archery, both of which contribute to our supremacy on the battlefield.

falconry_mastery.d: Deeply rooted in our culture, falconry represents a bond forged between our people and these magnificent birds of prey, and we have finely honed our skill in this ancient art. Our falconers are renowned for their ability to train these majestic raptors to hunt and capture prey.

rich_lands.d: Our lands are rich with fertile soil and abundant resources from the prairies to the dense forests, ready to be transformed by our hardy men and women. We will use every tool at our disposal to wisely manage the land we have been gifted, and thereby bring prosperity to every household.

jurchen_honor.d: Our people are enthusiastic about feats of strength and other demonstrations of skill, as each Jurchen feels that by showing off their abilities they earn the respect of their peers. This well-earned self-respect makes our warriors immensely brave, ready to fight anyone.

unite_the_tribes.d: Since the birth of our nation, the Jurchen people have been unified and divided into multiple tribes and alliances, and not always friendly ones. This dynamic has been constant for as long as we can remember — as has the urge to unify all our tribes under a single banner. The time has come to satisfy this long-cherished desire!

leader_under_sky.d: Our people have been divided for too long, and we need someone strong enough to unite them and make the world tremble at our feet. The Sky will direct the acts and thoughts of this leader, and guide us to a bright future.

foraging_our_way.d: We are hunters and live in communion with nature, even those of us dwelling in cities. It is in our blood to find the correct path in a dark forest; to know which of Nature's gifts to take with us. This wisdom lets us survive everywhere without difficulty.

the_eight_banners.d: The Eight Banner System is the core of our society and military. Through hereditary membership and grants of land and income, the Banners are granted elite status, and for good reason — from the conquest of our neighbors to future campaigns, our dominance depends on their might.

deliberative_council.n: Deliberative Council of Princes and Ministers
deliberative_council.d: Originally called the 'Council of Deliberation', this body evolved from informal institutions that promoted collaborative governance among the leaders of the realm. The Council's structure has been transformed, focusing on collective aristocratic governance and policy deliberations, mainly in foreign and military affairs. Membership is restricted to military leaders from outside the imperial clan, ensuring elite participation while maintaining the ultimate authority of the ruler.

manchu_script.d: The Manchu alphabet has emerged, combining Classical Mongolian characters with Jurchen phonetics. This unique writing system facilitates left-to-right vertical column writing. With diverse letter forms and contextual adaptability for initial, medial, final, and isolated positions, it preserves the most subtle nuances of our language.

c.t: Is or was the country China (CHI)

a_new_dawn.d: Our nation has been reborn. The old ways of living are gone, like dreams melting into the morning light. It is time for us to face the world as a fully modernized nation.

c.t: Is or was the country China (CHI)

manchu_reborn.d: As our nation has undergone fundamental transformations, so will our army. The world has opened itself to us, and new challenges will appear on the horizon. If we want to survive in this new paradigm, we have to be ready to act.

bah_arabian_horses.d: The climate of India is suboptimal at best for breeding and raising horses. The horses of Arabia, however, are superb mounts that outclass our local breeds. We will use our trade connections to ensure that we have a steady supply of these horses for our troops.

bah_amir_rebellion.d: Our state was born from the rebellion of Amir Hasan Gangu against the pathetic rule of Delhi. The victory against the Dehlavi Sultanate still lives on in the minds of our own nobility and military to this day.

bah_nobility_hindu_expansion.d: Although at times a challenge to the sovereignty of the ruler, the noble class is nonetheless useful to our government, as they are crucial in administrating our vast properties. With winning our independence from Delhi, we gained rulership over almost exclusively Hindu subjects, while our Muslim nobles are a small minority, unable to manage the masses. We must expand and stabilize our aristocracy by promoting promising Hindu candidates into their ranks.

bah_gharbians.d: Cutting ties with Delhi to found our own kingdom has loosened our connection with the Muslim-dominated northern parts of India. As our state lacks any form of entrenched Muslim aristocracy, we are in a precarious situation, and we could end up entirely at the mercy of local Hindu nobles. Fortunately, our reputation precedes us. Tales of the riches of the Deccan are told and retold all over the Muslim world, and many ambitious fortune-seekers make the sea voyage to our ports. By using the vast riches of India to attract talented westerners, or Gharbians, to our court, we can ensure that our country shall never lack able minds to lead our armies, collect our taxes, and rule our subjects.

bah_legacy_of_gisu_daraz.d: India in general, and our state in particular, has a history as a center of Sufi teachings. The efforts of our rulers to attract and patronize Sufi sheiks from all over the world are a testament to the piety and the great spiritual strength of our monarchs and our court. The state adopting the Sufi concepts of spiritual sovereignty and the inclusive nature of the Sufi teachings themselves will help create an environment where the diverse religious faiths of Gharbians and the natives of Deccan alike can mix and thrive without clashes or unproductive quarrels.

bah_meltpot_of_languages.d: Deccan is a region of many languages and cultures; the great influx of people of Iranian, Turkic, Afghan, and Arabian descent into these lands has accentuated the cosmopolitan nature of our state. While historically the Persian language fulfilled the needs of our predecessors, a new mix of local languages — as well as Persian and Arabic — has grown increasingly common. This mixture of languages has even become a source of cultural inspiration for emerging artists.

bah_karimis.d: For centuries, the Indo-Egyptian trade has been dominated by Egypt-based groups of traders and captains known as the Kārimī. Instrumental in the day-to-day business of Indian Ocean trade, this merchant organization is now both wealthy and powerful. From the Tamil coasts and the ports of the Swahili trading cities to the Lower Egyptian port cities past the Gulf of Aden, sultans, nobles, and commoners alike come to buy exotic goods or borrow money for their projects from the Kārimī. This organization has lately taken a very active interest in our state, and we only stand to gain from cultivating our relationship with them further.

bah_takht_e_firoza.d: The first thing any guest in our royal audience chamber notices is the Turquoise Throne of our dynasty. This unique piece of royal furniture was originally donated to us by the defeated Telugu Raja Kapaya, and it is in many ways the ultimate symbol of our dynasty. Exquisite and splendidly unique, it embodies the riches of the Deccan and the unusual combination of styles that is the hallmark of our cosmopolitan state.

bah_bahmani_primogeniture.d: Our unusual practice of always passing the throne to the eldest son of the current ruler has at times created some instability in our realm, as power-hungry regents and opportunistic nobles initially showed little hesitation in trying to take advantage of a child ruler or in supporting an envious relative's claim to the throne. By now, however, the practice has become firmly institutionalized, and when the time for succession comes there are very few who would oppose the true heir of our dynasty.

bah_madrasa_of_mahmud_gawan.d: For many years now, our state has drained able men from the greater Muslim world, while also incorporating the best of the states that came before us. This has created a rich cosmopolitan culture that is not entirely Farsi, Arabian, Marathi, Telugu, nor Kannadiga in nature. Creating a major madrasa in our capital would serve to further the development of learning this multitude of cultures and also allow the world to see the greatness of our state.

leonese_asturian_inheritance.d: Our kingdom traces its unbroken political descent from the Christian remnant kingdom of Asturias, the only Iberian realm that never submitted to the conquering Umayyad caliphate after 711. We carry forward the legitimist banner of the Reconquista along with the codes, monasteries, and noble lineages that the Asturian dynasty preserved through two centuries of mountain refuge. This deep dynastic continuity legitimizes every act of our Crown and binds the populations we absorb to a story they cannot easily refuse.

leonese_gothic_art.d: Our cathedral of León — the Pulchra Leonina — crowns the kingdom with the most expansive stained-glass program in Christian Iberia, its master stonemasons and glaziers trained in the ateliers that completed Chartres and Reims. We will sponsor new collegiate churches, royal foundations, and Cistercian abbeys on the same compositional principles, providing steady employment to the lineages whose techniques sustain the tradition. This architectural-artistic culture deepens our soft power and reduces the cost of every monumental building our Crown commissions.

leonese_pendon_morado.d: The Pendón Morado — the purple banner with the silver lion that has marched at the head of every Leonese muster since the creation of the realm — carries a continuity of regional identity that survives every dynastic merger our kingdom undergoes. By placing it ceremonially at every concejo meeting and every parish festival, we knit together the towns, valleys, and pastoral commons under a single visible emblem that no centralizing decree can erase. This symbolic continuity prevents our provincial identity from fading and gives every Leonese a stake in defending what the banner stands for.

leonese_textile_industry.d: The wool from our Tierra de Campos sheep — long-stapled, weather-hardened, and abundant — feeds a network of workshops in León, Astorga, Salamanca, and Zamora that produce the rough cloth our peasants and our infantry depend on. We extend royal protection to the cloth guilds and standardize measures along the Paños de León supply chain that runs from upland pasture to the Medina del Campo spring and autumn fairs. This integrated wool-and-cloth chain gives our economy a manufacturing base that survives whatever short-term price shocks the wool trade encounters.

leonese_provincial_academies.d: Across our principal cities local enlightenment circles have founded Sociedades Económicas and learned academies that publish memoirs on agriculture, manufacturing, and natural history. These bodies operate without Crown subsidy by attracting clergy, nobles, and burgher subscribers who treat patriotic improvement as a duty of their station. This provincial intellectual network raises literacy across our region and produces a steady supply of administrators competent enough to serve Crown projects far beyond our borders.

leonese_industrial_revival.d: The coal seams of Asturias and the iron deposits of the Bierzo and Vega de Riosa power a regional industrial revival that brings our mountain valleys back into the European economic mainstream after centuries on the margin. Foreign engineers partner with local capital to open minas and fundiciones that transform raw ore into pig iron, rail, and shipplate. This industrial base diversifies our economy beyond pastoral wool and dairy and gives our skilled labor a wage premium that draws migrants back from the Atlantic emigrant ships.

ligurian_coastal_seafarers.d: Every community along the Ligurian Riviera — from the fishing harbors of Ventimiglia to the hillside villages above La Spezia — has for centuries sent men to sea in small coastal boats, mastering the currents, hazards, and weather of one of the most demanding coastlines in the Mediterranean. This tradition of practical seamanship produced sailors of unusual quality long before any of our cities built deep-water warships, and the coastal cabotage trade that these men sustained carried goods between ports that no inland road could reach as efficiently. This seafaring heritage gives our merchants a natural edge in coastal and regional trade and ensures that any galley fleet we put to sea is crewed by men who already know the water.

ligurian_merchant_diaspora.d: The merchants of our coast did not wait for the great trading cities to invite them in — they established colonies, agencies, and partnerships in every port they could reach, from the Black Sea settlements of Caffa and Pera to the counting houses of Seville and Lisbon. These Colonie operated on networks of trust and kinship that made Ligurian credit as reliable in Alexandria as at home, and the information that flowed along those networks gave our merchants an advantage in every market they entered. This diaspora turns geography from a limitation into an asset, extending our commercial reach far beyond what the size of our fleet alone would justify.

ligurian_spirit_of_navigation.d: The Ligurian coast has produced navigators out of all proportion to its size — Cristoforo Colombo, who opened the western Atlantic to Castilian ambition, Giovanni Caboto, who mapped the northern coast of the New World for the English crown, and a generation of pilots whose skills carried them into every ocean that European ships reached. This tradition of producing men willing to sail beyond the horizon with imperfect charts has given Ligurian seamanship a reputation that attracts investment and patronage from courts that would otherwise never look at our small coast. This culture of navigation elevates our standing among foreign powers and draws skilled settlers and fortune-seekers to our harbors from distant lands.

ligurian_artisan_craft.d: The workshops of the Ligurian coast have developed a tradition of decorative craftsmanship — silver Filigrànn-a (Filigrana in standard Italian: filigree) from the city's goldsmiths, maiolica fired in the kilns of Albisola, and intricate velvet weaves that our weavers first perfected in the fourteenth century — that found buyers wherever wealthy patrons sought something finer than the common market could supply. This artisan culture thrived in the same workshops that produced the less glamorous goods of daily commerce, giving our craftsmen a flexibility that purely luxury-focused guilds could not match. This tradition of decorative excellence attracts the most skilled artists of the age to settle among us and ensures that the work they produce commands premium prices wherever it is sold.

ligurian_communal_councils.d: The self-governing communes that had managed Ligurian harbor life for centuries were gradually formalized and rationalized, replacing informal custom with written charters, elected committees, and standardized administrative procedures that reduced the friction of local governance. These reformed councils gave the merchant class a structured forum for managing the affairs of their communities without dependence on noble patronage or distant judicial authority, embedding a civic competence in the institutions of every Ligurian town. This administrative tradition gives our government an unusual depth of trained civic talent and makes our institutions more responsive to the needs of the burghers who sustain our commerce.

ligurian_enlightenment.d: The philosophers and jurists of Liguria have engaged as deeply with Enlightenment thought as any school in Europe, arguing that the principles of reason and natural law demand a wholesale rethinking of how states govern and laws are made. We draw on this tradition to reform our institutions from within, replacing custom and privilege with codified procedure and bringing the best administrative minds of the age into public service. This commitment to rational governance makes our laws clearer, our reforms cheaper, and our state harder to destabilize.

milanese_tradition.d: The cities of Lombardy have governed themselves through elected consuls and independent courts since the time of the Lombard League, building a tradition of civic law that no emperor has managed to fully dismantle. We draw on this legacy by codifying these municipal liberties into a formal charter, granting our towns a recognized degree of self-governance in exchange for their loyal contribution of taxes and troops. This compact between the crown and the city keeps our urban population engaged and invested, reducing the friction that bleeds other states dry whenever they need to call on their subjects.

patron_of_music.d: Lombard merchants and bankers have established themselves across European cities for generations, lending to courts and trading houses that find no more reliable source of credit anywhere else. By formalizing this reputation through regulated exchange houses and letters of credit with fixed terms, we make our financial network a deliberate instrument of the state rather than a scattered collection of private ventures. This reach into foreign treasuries gives us a voice in the courts of Europe that our military strength alone could never secure.

c.t: Is or was the country Padua (PAD)

age_of_condottieri.d: The canal network that threads through the Lombard plain started as a simple irrigation system but has grown into the arteries of our entire regional economy, connecting Milan to the Po and carrying grain, timber, and finished goods at a fraction of the cost of road transport. We have invested in widening and deepening these waterways, building new locks that allow heavier barges to move year-round without depending on seasonal water levels. This network cuts the cost of supplying our cities and moving troops, making Lombardy one of the most efficiently administered territories in Italy.

merchant_princes.d: Michelangelo Merisi, born in a small town near Bergamo, developed a way of painting light and shadow so direct and brutal that it made the work of every other school look artificial by comparison. His followers spread the Chiaroscuro technique from our cities to Rome, Naples, and Madrid, and patrons have started to commission works explicitly in the Lombard manner. This reputation turns our cities into destinations for collectors and scholars, and the artists we train are in demand everywhere they go.

lombard_silk_masters.d: The mulberry groves and silk workshops of Lake Como and the Lombard plain supply the courts of Europe with the finest silk cloth available, and our weavers have refined the production process to a degree that foreign competitors struggle to replicate. We protect this advantage by regulating the export of raw silk and the techniques of our master weavers, ensuring that the value-added work stays within our borders rather than leaving as cheap raw material. This control over the full production chain turns silk from a local trade into a steady source of revenue that holds its value even when other commodity prices fall.

lombard_the_manifattura.d: In the foothills around Bergamo and Como, English spinning frames and power looms are replacing the old cottage workshops, and the mills running off Alpine streams have begun producing cloth faster and cheaper than any hand-weaver can match. We have invested in this transition by building company towns and bringing in foreign engineers to train our workers, turning what was a scatter of family looms into a modern industry. This manufacturing base makes Lombardy the productive heart of Italy, and the wealth it generates flows into every corner of our territory.

nair_military_advance.d: The Nairs are a diverse group of Hindu castes from Malabar and have a long history of involvement with the military. Their experience, as well as their role for the Kalari, will be of great value in our current conflicts.

maltese_the_rahal_watch.d: The Maltese landscape has become defined by the Raħal (the village), centered around a fortified parish church. Unlike European feudal manors, the Maltese village is a tightly-knit kinship network where the common people manage their own local security. This fosters a culture of the 'Watchman State', where every villager is trained to spot sails on the horizon and retreat to the Dejma (local militia) posts, turning the islands into a decentralized, self-repairing defensive grid.

maltese_the_korsa.d: With the rise of Mediterranean piracy, Maltese commoners are joining the fray. By granting letters of marque, we can benefit the realm by creating a class of 'Sailor-Merchants' who see the sea as a battlefield for both profit and faith. This will turn us into the 'Vikings of the South', experts in boarding actions and coastal raiding. This maritime aggression will ensure the coastline is guarded by a fleet of aggressive, privately-funded coast guards who know every hidden cove.

maltese_the_bajada.d: Our culture has produced a specialized class of 'Night Runners,' or Bajada. These are men with deep knowledge of the area who can navigate the island's rocky karst and sheer cliffs in total darkness. In a military context, they are the ultimate tactical couriers, slipping through enemy lines or swimming between harbor forts during blockades. This culture of stealth will allow us, if institutionalized, to develop an army of spies that no enemy can detect.

maltese_the_modernized_dejma.d: In the wake of the new threats, the informal village watch known as the Dejma is in need of modernization. We will develop a national militia system where every male between 16 and 60 is assigned a specific post. This will create a culture of the 'Soldier-Peasant', where the agricultural cycle is intertwined with military drills. This widespread martial literacy will ensure that the islands can never be taken by a surprise landing, as the entire countryside functions as a high-readiness reserve force that supports the professional soldiers of the realm.

maltese_the_festa_ritualism.d: Our identity is centered on the Festa and religious processions, which are organized with military precision. These elaborate celebrations, characterized by grand processions, ornate street decorations, and communal banquets, serve as the primary glue for Maltese society. This culture of public piety and shared ritualism transcends class barriers, uniting the urban burghers and rural farmers in a common identity of intense religious devotion. By channeling their resources into the aesthetic and spiritual life of their local communities, the Maltese foster an incredible level of internal cohesion and social harmony, ensuring that the archipelago remains a unified and culturally vibrant society even under the pressures of external threats.

maltese_center_of_the_mediterranean.d: As our island lies in the middle of the Mediterranean Sea, our maritime culture has shifted toward industrial ship-repair and global logistics. Our Grand Harbor will become the premier naval dockyard of the world as local artisans adapt their ancient stone-working and carpentry skills to the era of steam and iron. This industrial seamanship will turn the islands into a global coaling station and repair hub, ensuring that our fleet remains technologically superior to those of our rivals.

maori_ta_moko_advance.d: With the intricate curves and spirals of Tā Moko, we ritualistically etch pigment into our very skin, transforming our bodies into living tapestries of honor and history.

maori_ceremonial_haka_advance.d: The ground shakes as our warriors perform the Haka, their fierce cries and synchronized movements echoing across the battlefield. This intimidating ceremonial war dance emboldens the heart of every warrior, granting a significant morale boost to land forces.

maori_whakapapa_advance.d: Strength and unity come from knowing one's Whakapapa, the intricate web of genealogical connections that binds an iwi together. This deep understanding of collective ancestry fosters a united front against all adversities.

maori_te_reo_advance.d: We know that by preserving and nurturing Te Reo, our sacred language, we maintain a vibrant connection to our culture and traditions.

maori_rua_kumara_advance.d: By perfecting the art of growing and storing kūmara tubers in specially-constructed rua, or storage pits, we can ensure that our bellies are filled even in the harshest of winters.

maori_he_whakaputanga_advance.d: The so-called 'Declaration of the Independence of New Zealand' is a document that once and for all establishes a unified Māori state that is independent. With the wording fully understood by all sides, our chieftains may finally unite, and be free from foreign interference.

mhr_tradition_of_military_service.d: Marathi cavalrymen have a long tradition of service as 'Bargirs' for the Deccan sultanates. The increased militarization of the Deccan due to the many wars fought in the area has made our cavalry one of the most dangerous forces in India.

mhr_peasant_soldiers.d: The villages of the Desh are full of able men who would be more than willing to serve in our armies. Let us recruit the Marathi-speaking members of our population into our military.

m: Can Enact Ashta Pradham Policy: yes

mhr_ashta_pradhan_advance.d: Ashta Pradhan - Modern Council of Ministers - is the system of ministerial delegation used by the Marathi people. The council is tasked with guiding the administration of the state, overviewing matters of the military, finances, diplomacy, and religion alike.

mhr_office_of_the_peshwa.d: The Peshwa Shall be our chief minister, entirely devoted to both civil administration and overseeing military operations. This consolidation of power will make us versatile enough to expand quickly and efficiently.

mhr_forts_of_maharashtra.d: In these hilly and densely forested lands, maintaining a series of forts is an offensive necessity as well as a defensive one. Meticulous maintenance of our fortifications should therefore be a top priority.

mhr_encourage_brahmin_ties.d: Our financial sector is dominated by Brāhmaṇa banking families. Let us integrate them further in our administration by hiring them as tax collectors, and creating regulations to strengthen their rights and protect their traditions. We will have gained the favor of our financiers as well as access to learned and able administrators.

median_lo_statuto_del_comune.d: Before most of Europe had thought to write its customs down, the cities of our region had already codified their laws, established their councils, and set out the duties of every citizen and magistrate in the pages of the Statuto. From Ancona to Viterbo, these documents were revised, contested, and renewed by each generation, creating a living tradition of civic argument that neither feudal lords nor passing conquerors could wholly extinguish. This heritage of written law makes our institutions resilient and our burghers invested in the city they help to govern.

median_studio_generale.d: The university at Perugia, founded in 1308, placed itself under civic rather than ecclesiastical authority, and the schools that followed across our region trained the lawyers, notaries, and administrators who carried the business of the Italian commune forward. Our cities offered the libraries, the patronage, and the debating culture that drew men of learning from across the peninsula, making legal and philosophical training as natural a product of central Italy as any craft. This tradition of learned governance gives our officials a preparation in law and argument that their counterparts in more purely feudal regions struggle to match.

median_bastioni_e_rocche.d: The Italian Wars proved that medieval curtain walls could not stop artillery for more than a morning, and our hill towns responded by turning their greatest natural asset — the ridge, the spur, the ravine — into systems of angled bastions and compact Rocche that made each town a distinct tactical problem. Architects and military engineers rebuilt our defenses in stone and rammed earth, positioning artillery platforms at the angles that most terrified attacking batteries. This tradition of fortification adapted to terrain makes our territories harder to overrun and far costlier for any invader to hold.

median_baroque_sacred_patronage.d: The religious upheavals of the age demanded a visual response, and our cities answered with an explosion of chapels, altarpieces, and sacred facades that transformed every urban skyline into a theater of piety. Confraternities, civic councils, and wealthy patrons competed to commission the most luminous images, the most dynamic sculptures, and the most persuasive devotional paintings their treasuries could afford. This tradition of sacred patronage sustains our artists, fills our streets with devotional imagery, and signals to every visitor that our culture lives at the center of a confident and expressive spiritual life.

median_jubilee_economy.d: The Holy Years that Rome declared every quarter-century brought pilgrims from every corner of Latin Christendom onto the roads of our territory, and the Grand Tour that followed brought a second wave of wealthy and curious northerners willing to pay generously for comfort, guidance, and company. Our inns, markets, and workshops learned to serve an international clientele, and the money they left behind flowed through every level of our economy. This tradition of hosting the faithful and the curious makes our cities prosperous far beyond what local production alone could sustain.

median_enlightenment_civic_reform.d: The rationalist currents of the eighteenth century found in our communal tradition a soil already prepared to receive them — cities long accustomed to debating their own governance, recording their decisions, and holding their magistrates to account in writing. Reform-minded governors and learned academies pushed for clearer codes, more orderly urban plans, and more predictable administration across the towns and countryside we govern. This embrace of rational governance makes our institutions more efficient and our subjects more inclined to see the state as a partner in civic life rather than an obstacle to it.

c.t: Has government reform: Partitio Terrarum Imperii Romaniae

mercantile_spirit.d: Naples, inspired by the influential maritime republic of Amalfi, boasts a vibrant culture of trade. Strategic ports, including the city of Naples itself, served as vital hubs, connecting the kingdom to distant lands and fostering economic prosperity through commercial exchanges and the flourishing exchange of goods and ideas.

c.t: Has government reform: Partitio Terrarum Imperii Romaniae

consolidate_the_royal_domain.d: We have inherited a wealthy realm, but we have been stymied from achieving true prosperity by the constraints of archaic laws and customs. Previous rulers balanced noble privilege with economic power, but we must bring attitude and regulations into the modern era. By strengthening courts of the nobility and consolidating their landholdings, we will create a clearer legal hierarchy. Simultaneously, we will empower cities as centers of royal authority and encourage the proliferation of urban trade and craftsmanship.

c.t: Has government reform: Partitio Terrarum Imperii Romaniae

crush_the_barons.d: Local barons still exert a large degree of power over the Neapolitan countryside. If we wish to continue centralizing our kingdom, we must crush the power of these barons, or risk them conspiring against us.

c.t: Has government reform: Partitio Terrarum Imperii Romaniae

city_of_artists.d: Through patronage of the world's greatest artists, the glory of our city will become known throughout the world. All will marvel at the greatness of our painters, poets, singers, and actors. Let Neapolitan culture be the mark by which other centers of art are measured!

c.t: Has government reform: Partitio Terrarum Imperii Romaniae

a_central_power.d: Our advantageous central position in the Mediterranean enables effortless access to any shore. We should capitalize on this asset to seek alliances, forge new friendships, and expand our borders. With the sea as our gateway, opportunities abound for growth and prosperity in our quest for greater influence and security.

c.t: Has government reform: Partitio Terrarum Imperii Romaniae

neapolitan_army_reforms.d: Our nation needs to undergo sweeping military reforms, modernizing its armed forces to meet the challenges of the changing battlefield. These reforms will bolster tactical capabilities, streamline command structures, and enhance training programs, positioning us as a formidable force in our region.

npl_himalayan_homeland.d: Our people have lived since time immemorial in the shadow of very mountains that sustain the Heavens. The high passes, the steep ridgelines, the deep-cut river valleys — these are not obstacles to us but the very fabric of our homeland. Even the air itself is different than that of the lowlands, and no army from the plains can expect to move through these lands as our soldiers do.

npl_the_divya_upadesh.d: The Divya Upadesh lays out nine principles that form the core of political and national life in Nepal, as well as guidelines for successful foreign policy. It encapsulates centuries of Nepali thought on governance, war, and peace. Following these principles, Nepal shall be able to avoid the subversion of nearby empires and marauding foreigners.

npl_gurkhas.d: Gurkha are troops of Nepali origins (as their name are quite interchangeable) who are infamous for their unbreakable bravery and discipline in combat.

flemish_cloth_making.d: The Late Middle Ages saw the birth of a powerful textile industry in the Low Countries. Manufactured from imported English and Castilian wool, fabric of the highest quality were exported to all of Europe.

polders_advance.d: The Low Countries are highly susceptible to flooding, and the many disastrous floods that happened between the 11th and 14th centuries led to the creation of the Zuiderzee. This excessive flooding also caused coastal soils to become uselessly salinated. Thankfully, we now have the technology to reclaim this damaged land and use it productively for agriculture.

netherlandish_ship_building.d: As the Low Countries are home to some of Europe's greatest port cities, it is only fitting that they should also boast some of Europe's greatest shipyards. Being able to employ skilled local craftsmen dramatically reduces the costs of acquiring new merchant fleets.

piedmontese_the_ricet.d: Specially linked to the Piedmontese countryside, villages have traditionally developed the Ricetto (in standard Italian and Ricèt in Piedmontese) — a fortified area within the town used to store the community's grain and wine and provide refuge during raids. This is not a lord's castle, but a communal asset managed by the villagers. This has allowed the peasantry to survive the frequent wars between the various nations of the area, ensuring that the state's productive capacity remains intact even during invasions.

piedmontese_le_fere_del_piemont.d: The Piedmontese cities have been formalizing great trade fairs across the region. By providing state protection and tax exemptions for international merchants, the state will turn the Alpine crossings into corridors of wealth. This will bring us riches, providing the necessary funds to purchase the loyalty of independent lords.

piedmontese_the_piassafort.d: Recognizing our position as the gateway to Italy, we will begin transforming our cities into Piassafòrt (Fortress-Cities). This will require a cultural reinforcement toward living under constant threat, where city planning is dictated by the needs of artillery and garrisons. This engineering excellence will make Piedmont the most difficult region in Italy to conquer, forcing foreign powers to negotiate rather than invade.

piedmontese_the_nebbiolo_vigne.d: While cultivated since antiquity, we will implement a scientific approach to viticulture in the vineyards of our region. By supporting the modernization and standardization of the vineyards and regulating the production of high-value wines (Nebbiolo), the state will ensure a luxury export that generates massive trade revenue. These measures will provide the treasury with a stable income that is immune to the fluctuations of the grain market.

piedmontese_the_canal.d: Our administration will undertake a titanic effort to tame the waters of our main rivers: the Po, the Dora, and the Sesia. By constructing an intricate network of stone canals and sluices, we will transform the flooded plains and abundant marshes into the most productive rice and grain fields in Southern Europe. This will provide the region with a massive, reliable food surplus, allowing the population to grow and sustain a permanent standing army unaffected by foreign grain imports.

piedmontese_the_setajoj.d: Piedmont will become the silk capital of Europe, characterized by massive silk factories (Filatoi) that will utilize advanced hydraulic machinery. This will create an early industrial culture in our towns, where a new class of technical artisans and merchants will emerge. These investments will provide the region with the capital needed to fund modern infrastructure and military upgrades, linking the Piedmontese economy directly to the global market.

pun_breadbasket_of_india.d: The five great rivers — Indus, Jhelum, Chenab, Ravi, and Sutley — penetrate the lands of the Punjab area, granting the soil the blessing of unmatched fertility. Apart from allowing us to export food and cotton to our neighbors, this also allows our many cities to grow and encourages all sorts of specialized production. We must do our utmost to encourage the growth of agriculture and to defend our farmers from the bandits and brigands in the adjoining areas.

pun_encourage_indo_persian_trade.d: Situated on the westernmost border of India, the Punjab has always been at the crossroads of economic and cultural exchange between India and Persia. The ancient Grand Trunk Road, which connects eastern India to the Farsi world, runs right through our lands before heading up into the Afghan mountain passes. These passes are, however, plagued by tribal raiders and bandits. We should encourage the traffic along this ancient and vibrant route and do everything in our power to look after the wellbeing of these traders by constructing caravanserais and policing these roads.

pun_gurmukhi_script.d: The Gurmukhī script is an abugida developed in the lands of Punjab, and is highly favored by our Sikh gurus. Our clergy is using this script in order to record Sikh texts.

pun_foundation_of_the_khalsa.d: Sikhism, a religion native to the Punjab, is spreading rapidly in our lands. Members of this faith come from all castes and backgrounds, and will defend their state regardless of their former professions.
